Acidic Poison Cloud Trap.name: Acidic Poison Cloud Trap
Acidic Poison Cloud Trap.description: Cinco boquillas ocultas en el techo del apartamento expulsan densas nubes de veneno acido desde un deposito reforzado tras la pared.
Acidic Poison Cloud Trap.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:35|name:Block One Nozzle|traits:action:disable-a-device] (experto) to block one of the nozzles or @Check[thievery|dc:40|name:Shut Off the Tank|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) to shut off the tank. La trampa deactivates after 5 asaltos, once the tank is empty.
Acidic Poison Cloud Trap.hpDetails: to destroy a nozzle; Tank Hardness 20; TankHP 100 (UR 50) to daño the tank enough to stop it from spewing gas
Acidic Poison Cloud Trap.routine: (1 action) When it's triggered, the trap has five active nozzles, but at the end of its turn each round, one random nozzle deactivates. On the trap's turn, the active nozzles emit a cloud of acidic poison gas that expands to fill the apartment. The cloud deals @Damage[1d6[acid]] daño and @Damage[1d6[poison]] daño per active nozzle to each criatura and object in the room (@Check[fortitude|dc:33|basic|name:Spew Cloud|traits:poison] salvación). Unattended objects automatically fail saves to avoid the daño.

action->Displacement.name: Displacement
action->Displacement.description:
An astradaemon bends light, appearing shifted from its true position, though still in the same space.

Las criaturas targeting the astradaemon must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11] check, as if the astradaemon were hidden, even though it remains observed.

Effects such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.y2XeMe1F18lIyo59]{Blind-Fight} feat and halfling's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.ancestryfeatures.Item.y1EmCv2cEb5hXBwx]{Keen Eyes} that apply on the prueba plana against hidden criaturas also apply against a displaced astradaemon.

action->Soul Siphon.name: Sifón de almas
action->Soul Siphon.description:
30 pies. An astradaemon draws power from the souls of the recently slain. If a Small or larger living criatura dies within its aura, the astradaemon gains 5 Puntos de Golpe temporales and a +1 bonificador de estado to attack and tiradas de daño for 1 asalto, unless the criatura was slain by an astradaemon's Devour Soul ability.

Incorporeal undead and living spirits traveling outside the body take @Damage[1d8[force]] daño each round within the daemon's aura from the spiritual pressure as the astradaemon pulls in fragments of their soul.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.SjrM6XVTLySToS12]{Efecto: Soul Siphon}

action->Essence Drain.name: Essence Drain
action->Essence Drain.description:
When an astradaemon hits with its claw, jaws, or tail, it drains el objetivo's spiritual and vital essences.

El objetivo takes @Damage[2d10[void]] daño and the astradaemon regains an equal number of Puntos de Golpe. El objetivo must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:37|traits:damaging-effect] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Condenado 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1}.

If el objetivo was already drained or doomed, it instead increases both conditions' value by 1, to a maximum of 4.

action->Mortal Shell.name: Mortal Shell
action->Mortal Shell.description:
Requisitos The astradaemon has killed a Large or smaller criatura with Overtake Soul within the past 24 horas and that criatura is within the daemon's reach

Efecto The astradaemon takes over and wears the body of their victim. Este automatically creates a disguise to allow the astradaemon to Impersonate el objetivo criatura. The body has a number of Puntos de Golpe equal to 3 times the level of the criatura. Any daño targeting the astradaemon damages the body first. Once the body is reduced to 0 Puntos de Golpe, it's destroyed and forces the astradaemon out, back to the daemon's normal form. If the astradaemon takes any daño de espíritu while wearing the body, the daño is dealt to the astradaemon directly and it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] check or be forced out of the body. Additionally, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ihbRf964JDXztcy3]{Disjunction} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} can force the astradaemon out of the body with a successful counteract check against DC 41.

While wearing the disguise, the astradaemon's attacks use the reach of the body it inhabits, and its size changes to match that of the criatura whose soul it consumed. Additionally, the astradaemon is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 4} while wearing the disguise. (Estos penalties haven't been incorporated into this stat block.)

action->Overtake Soul.name: Overtake Soul
action->Overtake Soul.description:
Requisitos The astradaemon hasn't used an action with the attack rasgo yet this turn.

Efecto The astradaemon draws out and consumes the soul of a living criatura it has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado}. The criatura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:39|traits:damaging-effect] salvación or instantly die. If it dies, the astradaemon gains 10 Puntos de Golpe temporales.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.xiOi7btey4AS6jhe]{Efecto: Overtake Soul}

action->Smoke Vision.description: Smoke doesn't impair an agradaemon's vision; it ignores the concealed condition from smoke.

action->Choking Smog.name: Choking Smog
action->Choking Smog.description: 100 pies. The agradaemon is surrounded by ashy smoke. Las criaturas within the aura are concealed, and criaturas outside of it are concealed to criaturas within it. Non-daemon criaturas can't breathe in the aura and must hold their breath or suffocate.

action->Daemonic Pledge.name: Daemonic Pledge
action->Daemonic Pledge.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto The agradaemon designates a single willing mortal as a pledged fanatic. That criatura gains resistance to fire equal to its level, immunity to the agradaemon's choking smog aura, and smoke vision.

The agradaemon can have up to 10 pledged fanatics at one time and can remove the status from any number of pledged fanatics as a free action with the concentrate rasgo. The status can also be removed with an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.

action->Proven Devotion.name: Proven Devotion
action->Proven Devotion.description:
The agradaemon regains @Damage[15[untyped]] Puntos de Golpe, and a pledged fanatic of the agradaemon's choice that it can see loses 15 Puntos de Golpe (no effects apply that would decrease this Hit Point loss).

A pledged criatura that dies in this way explodes and deals @Damage[9d10[fire]|options:area-damage] daño in a @Template[emanation|distance:20] (@Check[reflex|dc:41|basic|options:area-effect] salvación).

weapon->Tanglefoot Bag (Moderate).description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.evBPzM1VsuYcoenn]

Activar 1 Golpe

A tanglefoot bag is filled with sticky substances. When tú hit a criatura with a tanglefoot bag, that criatura takes a -15-pies penalización de estado to its Velocidades for 1 minuto. Obtienes a +1 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque, and the Escape DC is 19.

On a impacto crítico, a criatura in contact with a solid surface becomes stuck to the surface and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} for 1 asalto, and a criatura flying via wings has its wings tangled, causing it to fall safely to the ground and become unable to Fly again for 1 asalto. Tanglefoot bags are not effective when used on a criatura that is in water.

El objetivo can end any effects by Escaping or spending a total of 3 actions to carefully remove the sticky substances. Estos INTERACT actions don't have to be consecutive, and other criaturas can provide the actions as well.

equipment->Alchemist Goggles.description:
Estos brass goggles are engraved with flame patterns and have thick, heavy lenses.

While worn, they give tú a +1 bonificador por objeto to CRAFTING checks to Craft alchemical items and a +1 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque with alchemical bombs.

Puedes also ignore lesser cover when making Golpes with alchemical bombs.

Formulas can also appear on parchment sheets, tablets, and almost any other medium; there's no need for tú to copy them into a specific book as long as puedes keep them on hand to reference them.

Any beneficial occult conjuros with a duration of 1 asalto or longer cast on the almiraj last twice as long.

action->Magic Horn.name: Magic Horn

action->Blasphemous Arms.description: Any arma gains the effects of an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.gmMrJREf4JSHd2dZ]{Unholy} property rune while Avsheros wields it.

action->Wail of the Betrayed.description:
Avsheros lets out an agonized wail that invokes grief and a feeling of betrayal in those who hear it.

All criaturas within 120 pies must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:47] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}. A criatura asustado in this way can't willingly accept aid of any kind from an ally until the asustado condition is removed.

On a successful save, the criatura is immune to Avsheros's Wail of the Betrayed for 24 horas.

The baatamidar can suppress this aura or activate it again as a free action.

action->Writhing Arms.name: Writhing Arms
action->Writhing Arms.description:
The baatamidar makes up to four tentacle Golpes, each against a different target. Each attack counts separately for the baatamidar's multiple attack penalización, but the penalización doesn't increase until the baatamidar has made all the attacks.

If the baatamidar subsequently uses the Improved GRAB action, it can GRAB any number of criaturas it hit with Writhing Arms.

action->Tear Flesh.description:
Desencadenante A criatura grabbed by the barnacle ghoul critically fails a prueba de habilidad to Escape

Efecto The barnacle ghoul makes a claw Golpe against the triggering criatura.

action->Consume Flesh.name: Consumir carne
action->Consume Flesh.description:
Requisitos The barnacle ghoul is adjacent to the corpse of a criatura that died within the last hour.

Efecto The barnacle ghoul devours a chunk of the corpse and regains @Damage[5d6[healing]] Puntos de Golpe.

It can regain Puntos de Golpe from any given corpse only once.

action->Fill Lungs.name: Fill Lungs
action->Fill Lungs.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:26]

Etapa 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2} (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 3} (1 asalto)

Etapa 4 drowning and cannot reduce below stage 4 until the water is purged; purging the water requires a successful @Check[medicine|dc:26|name:Purge Water|traits:manipulate,action:administer-first-aid] check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid} (which stops the criatura from drowning and returns the criatura to stage 3; stage 2 on a critical success) or a magical effect that removes curses or the sickened condition (which stops the criatura from drowning and ends the curse).

If the criatura dies from drowning, it rises as a barnacle ghoul the next midnight.

action->Nimble Swim.name: Nimble Swim
action->Nimble Swim.description: The barnacle ghoul Swims up to 20 pies. Este movement no desencadena reacciones.

action->Paralysis.name: Paralysis
action->Paralysis.description:
Any living, non-elf criatura hit by a ghoul's attack must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado}.

It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

action->Integrated Launcher.name: Integrated Launcher
action->Integrated Launcher.description: Un lanzaproyectiles esta integrado en los sistemas de un asesino mecanico, con 10 hojas giratorias y cinco bombas de humo. Cuando el asesino es destruido, el lanzador y su municion tambien son destruidos.

action->Smoke Vision.name: Smoke Vision
action->Smoke Vision.description: The clockwork assassin ignores the concealed condition from smoke.

action->Wind-Up.name: Wind-Up
action->Wind-Up.description: For the clockwork assassin to act, it must be wound with a unique key by another criatura. Este takes 1 minuto. Once wound, it remains operational for 24 horas, after which time it becomes unaware of its surroundings and can't act until it's wound again.The assassin can enter standby mode as a 3-action activity. Its operational time doesn't decrease in standby, but it can sense its surroundings (with a -2 penalización to Perception). It can't act, with one exception: when it perceives a criatura, it can exit standby as a reaction (rolling initiative if appropriate).A criatura can attempt a [[/act disable-device dc=33]]{DC 31 THIEVERY} check to Disable a Device to wind the assassin down. For each success, the assassin loses 1 hora of operational time. Este can be done even if the assassin is in standby mode.

action->Smoke Bomb Launcher.name: Smoke Bomb Launcher

Las criaturas within the area are concealed, and all other criaturas are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minuto or until dispersed by a strong wind.

consumable->Scroll of Monstrosity Form (.consumableSpellDescription:
Te transformas into the shape of a legendario monster, assuming a Huge battle form. Debes have enough space to expand into or the conjuro is lost. When tú cast this conjuro, elige phoenix, cave worm, or sea serpent. While in this form, obtienes the beast rasgo (for phoenix) or the animal rasgo (for cave worm or sea serpent). Puedes Dismiss the conjuro.

Obtienes the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form tú elige:

  • AC = 20 + tu level. Ignore tu armor's check penalización and Velocidad reduction.
  • 20 Puntos de Golpe temporales.
  • Darkvision.
  • One or more unarmed melee attacks specific to the battle form tú elige, which are the only attacks puedes Golpe with. Estás entrenado with them. Tu attack modifier is +28, and tú use the listed daño. Estos attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled} condition, for example). If tu ataque sin armas modifier is higher, puedes use it instead.
  • ATHLETICS modifier of +30, unless tu own modifier is higher.

Tú also gain specific abilities based on the type of monster tú elige:

  • Cave Worm

    • Velocidad 40 pies, burrow 30 pies, swim 20 pies;
    • Melee 1 jaws (reach 10 pies), Damage 2d12+20 piercing;
    • Melee 1 stinger (agile, reach 10 pies), Damage 2d8+15 piercing plus 2d6 persistent poison;
    • Melee 1 body (reach 10 pies) Damage 2d8+20 bludgeoning;
    • Inexorable Tú automatically recover from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} conditions at the end of each of tu turns. Estás also immune to being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.

  • Phoenix

    • Velocidad 30 pies, fly 90 pies;
    • Melee 1 beak (reach 15 pies), Damage 2d6+12 piercing plus 2d4 fire and 2d4 persistent fire;
    • Melee 1 talon (agile, reach 15 pies), Damage 2d8+12 slashing;
    • Shroud of Flame (aura, fire, primal) 20 pies. Obtienes an aura of fire that extends out from tú. A criatura that enters or ends its turn within the aura takes 2d6 daño de fuego. A criatura can take this daño only once per turn. Puedes activate or deactivate this aura with a Sustain action.

  • Sea Serpent

    • Velocidad 20 pies, swim 90 pies;
    • Melee 1 jaws (reach 15 pies), Damage 2d12+20 piercing;
    • Melee 1 tail (reach 25 pies), Damage 2d8+20 bludgeoning;
    • Spine Rake 2 (move) Tú extend tu spines and Swim or Zancada. Each criatura estás adjacent to at any point during tu movement takes 4d8+10 daño cortante (basic Reflex against tu conjuro DC).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conjuro-effects.Item.oMtbVNQ5YFmmQUlU]{Spell Efecto: Monstrosity Form}

action->Illusory Copies.name: Illusory Copies
action->Illusory Copies.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto Blune calls into existence [[/r 1d4+2 #illusory copies]] illusory copies of himself, which dance around him and copy his every movement, making it almost impossible to pinpoint the true Blune.

Any attack that would hit Blune has a random chance of hitting an illusory copy instead. Este effect lasts for up to 1 minuto or until all the copies are destroyed or Blune is incapacitated.

Once a copy is hit, it's destroyed. If an tirada de ataque fails to hit Blune's AC but doesn't critically fail, it destroys a copy but has no additional effect (even if the attack would normally have an effect on a failure). If an tirada de ataque is a critical success and would hit a copy, the copy is destroyed and the tirada de ataque becomes a success against Blune.

Once all the copies are destroyed, this ability ends.

action->Ferocious Devotion.name: Ferocious Devotion
action->Ferocious Devotion.description:
Cuando un illusory toady es destruido, ello dissolves into un puddle de cerulean quintessence before reforming a quasi-life once more. One asalto after ello es destruido, el toady starts re-forming. One asalto after que, el toady es completely healed y begins a fight once more.

Si damaged mientras ello es re-forming but before el process es complete, el toady es destruido but splits into two cerulean puddles que begin re-forming into two identical toadies 1 asalto later, cada con half el maximum PG de el original toady (este es similar a un @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.uQBOJfjtzEXvpLQz]{Ochre Jelly's} Split ability); el toadies begin re-forming 1 asalto later.

El toadies son permanently destruido solo by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ihbRf964JDXztcy3]{Disjunction} o si @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.agents-of-edgewatch-bestiary.Actor.sUrJ7jxzBiJTbwVo]{Blune} cae unconscious.

action->Amplify Spell.name: Amplify Spell
action->Amplify Spell.description:
The toady wills itself to become a conduit for Blune's next conjuro, empowering the conjuro.

The toady becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} until the beginning of its next turn.

If Blune Bandersworth is within 30 pies and Casts a Spell before the toady's next turn, the conjuro travels through the toady before redirecting toward its intended target.

The conjuro is heightened by 1 rank, to a maximum of 10th rank. The toady is then destroyed.

Boiling Fountains.name: Boiling Fountains
Boiling Fountains.description: Four pressure plates beneath el floorboards activate dragon-headed fountains en either side de el sala, que spray boiling agua across el area between them.
Boiling Fountains.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Disable Pressure Plate|traits:action:disable-a-device] (entrenado) to disable each pressure plate, @Check[thievery|dc:16|name:Jam Fountain|traits:action:disable-a-device] to jam each fountain, or @Check[thievery|dc:18|name:Deflect Fountain's Spray|traits:action:disable-a-device] to deflect a fountain's spray
Boiling Fountains.reset: Once un pressure plate tiene been activated, ello debe be reinicia manually.

action->Scalding Spray.name: Scalding Spray
action->Scalding Spray.description:
Desencadenante Weight is placed on one of the squares marked with "T" on the map, triggering a pressure plate

Efecto The fountains spray boiling water across their own squares and the 10-pies-by-20-pies area between them (marked with dotted lines), dealing @Damage[(4d6+4)[fire]|options:area-damage] daño to any criaturas in the area (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic|options:area-effect] salvación).

Boiling Tub Trap.name: Boiling Tub Trap
Boiling Tub Trap.description: Un snapped trip wire causes un alchemical bomb a detonate y blow up part de el tin tub, spilling boiling agua todos over el trampa's victim.
Boiling Tub Trap.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:32|name:Remove Trip Wire|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) to safely remove the trip wire from the bomb

action->Overflowing Boiling Water.name: Overflowing Boiling Water
action->Overflowing Boiling Water.description:
Desencadenante The trip wire is pulled or severed

Efecto An acid flask detonates, spraying acid at nearby criaturas and causing the tub of boiling water to burst in the same direction.

All criaturas in a @Template[cone|distance:5] east of the triggered boiling tub trap take @Damage[3d6[persistent,acid],(3[splash])[acid],(8d6+20)[fire]]{3d6 daño persistente de ácido, 3 daño de salpicadura de ácido, and 8d6+20 daño de fuego} (@Check[reflex|dc:31|basic|traits:acid,fire] salvación).

action->Rage.name: Furia
action->Rage.description:
Requisitos Bolar isn't fatigued or raging

Efecto Bolar gains 3 Puntos de Golpe temporales that last until the rage ends. While raging, he deals 2 daño adicional with melee attacks and takes a -1 penalización to AC. The rage lasts for 1 minuto, until there are no enemies Bolar can perceive, or until Bolar falls unconscious.

Once the rage ends, Bolar can't Rage again for 1 minuto.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.z3uyCMBddrPK5umr]{Efecto: Rage}

action->Bonesense (Imprecise) 30 feet.name: Bonesense (Imprecise) 30 pies
action->Bonesense (Imprecise) 30 feet.description: A bone skipper swarm identifies bones and criaturas with a skeletal system in the listed range.

action->Marrow Rot.name: Marrow Rot
action->Marrow Rot.description:
Marrow rot affects only criaturas with a skeletal system

Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

Onset 1 día

Etapa 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} (1 día)

Etapa 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2} (1 día)

Etapa 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1} (1 día)

action->Swarming Bites.name: Swarming Bites
action->Swarming Bites.description: Each enemigo in the swarm's space takes @Damage[3d6[piercing]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic]) save plus exposure to marrow rot.

0.label: to Track a criatura at half its Puntos de Golpe or fewer

action->Partial Amphibian.name: Partial Amphibian
action->Partial Amphibian.description: El bregdi puede breathe air for up a 10 minutos, o up a un hora so long as su piel remains wet.

action->Aquatic Ambush.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.HBrBrUzjfvj2gDXB]

50 pies

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AquaticAmbush]

action->Capsize.name: Capsize
action->Capsize.description: The bregdi tries to capsize an adjacent aquatic vessel of its size or smaller. It must succeed at an ATHLETICS check with a DC of 35 (reduced by 5 for each size smaller the vessel is than the bregdi) or the pilot's Sailing LORE DC, whichever is higher.

action->Swallow Whole.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.uJSseLa57HZYSMUu]

Medium, @Damage[(2d8+7)[bludgeoning]] daño, Rupture 18

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

action->Tug.name: Tug
action->Tug.description:
The bregdi pulls a criatura it can reach or a criatura holding something it can reach (such as a fishing line in the water).

The bregdi attempts an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the criatura's Fortitude DC. On a success, it pulls the criatura into an adjacent space. On a critical success, the bregdi can also make a jaws Golpe against the criatura pulled into an adjacent space.

Burning Chandelier Trap.name: Burning Chandelier Trap
Burning Chandelier Trap.description: Four grande flaming chandeliers swing wildly around el sala.
Burning Chandelier Trap.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:36|name:Disable a Chandelier|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) to disable a chandelier or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (8th rank; counteract DC 33) to permanently drain the magic from a chandelier. Any amount of daño de frío that overcomes a chandelier's cold resistance extinguishes its flames and removes its daño persistente de fuego and flame dart attack. @Check[thievery|dc:41|name:Disable Trap (Control Panel)|traits:action:disable-a-device] (legendario) to disable the entire trap from the hidden control panel in the southeast corner of the room.
Burning Chandelier Trap.reset: La trampa deactivates and resets 1 minuto after there are no living criaturas remaining in the room.
Burning Chandelier Trap.routine: (4 actions) For every chandelier disabled, the trap's actions are reduced by 1. For each of the trap's actions, a different chandelier attacks a random criatura in the room. A chandelier uses its swinging chandelier attack if it can, but it can't make melee attacks against criaturas in the cage, the closet, or the gap between the two double doors leading into the vault. Against a criatura it can't reach with a melee attack, it uses a flame dart attack instead. La trampa doesn't take multiple attack penalties.
Burning Chandelier Trap.stealth: (maestro) or @Check[perception|dc:38|traits:action:seek] (maestro) to spot the trap's control panel

action->Extending Chandeliers.name: Extending Chandeliers
action->Extending Chandeliers.description:
Desencadenante A criatura touches the cage door, the closet door, or any wooden stand

Efecto Both double doors leading out of the room shut and lock; while the trap is active, the key doesn't work to open these doors (although their locks can be picked normally). The chandeliers drop several pies on elongated chains, allowing them to swing around the room. The closest chandelier to the triggering criatura makes a swinging chandelier Golpe against it. La trampa then rolls initiative.

weapon->+2 Greater Striking axiomatic Sc.name: +2 Greater Striking axiomatic Scourge
weapon->+2 Greater Striking axiomatic Sc.description: A scourge-also known as a cat-o'-nine-tails-is a set of several knotted cords made from cotton or leather and attached to a handle. While most scourges are more suitable for torture than combat, the armas used by the Order of the Scourge have metal barbs woven in to pierce clothing and armor. The scourge is a martial melee arma.

armor->+2 Resilient Hellknight Plate.name: +2 Resilient Hellknight Plate
armor->+2 Resilient Hellknight Plate.description: Few armors in the Inner Sea region are as memorable as the iconic Hellknight plate. While each order has its own flourishes, Hellknight plate is instantly recognizable to any who know of the Hellknights. Hellknights go to extreme measures to punish non-Hellknights who get their hands on Hellknight plate, and the reward is not usually worth the risk, since for non-Hellknights, the armor is functionally similar to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Gq1cZWSKOtJhKd2p]{Full Plate}.

ammo->Bolts.name: Virotes
ammo->Bolts.description: Mas cortos que las flechas tradicionales pero de construccion similar, los virotes son la municion que usan las ballestas.

action->Diabolic Certitude.name: Certeza diabólica
action->Diabolic Certitude.description: When making a Recall Knowledge check about a devil she's observing, siempre que Calennia rolls a critical failure, she gets a failure instead.

action->Flog Mercilessly.name: Flog Mercilessly
action->Flog Mercilessly.description: Calennia Golpes with her scourge. On a hit, she rolls daño three times. Este daño is combined (for the purpose of overcoming daño resistance, for example).

action->Terrible Justice.name: Terrible Justice
action->Terrible Justice.description:
Desencadenante A living criatura within 30 pies is reduced to 0 Puntos de Golpe

Efecto Calennia targets the criatura with a death knell conjuro (DC 34). If el objetivo dies, all of Calennia's enemies within 60 pies are targeted by a fear conjuro (DC 34). A criatura that succeeds at either save is temporarily immune to this ability for 24 horas.

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.kdhbPaBMK1d1fpbA]
Telepathy 100 pies

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.JcaIJLGGmst79f1Y]
Thoughtsense (Imprecise) 120 pies

action->Disgorge Portal.name: Disgorge Portal
action->Disgorge Portal.description:
The camarach vomits a spray of coruscating light. Este has the effect of a DC 42 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.d6o52BnjViNz7Gub]{Prismatic Spray}, except that each criatura is affected by one violet beam and one other beam (roll 1d6 instead of 1d8 to determine which other beam).

The camarach can't Disgorge a Portal again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Disgorge a Portal]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Exile.name: Exile
action->Exile.description:
The camarach shunts one criatura within its body through an inner portal to send it away.

El objetivo must attempt a @Check[will|dc:38] salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura is teleported to an open space it chooses within 30 pies of the camarach.

Éxito The criatura isn't teleported.

Fallo The criatura is teleported to a random open space 1 mile from the camarach.

Fallo crítico The criatura is teleported to a random other plane, as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport}.

action->Fast Swallow.name: Tragar rápido
action->Fast Swallow.description:
Desencadenante The camarach Grabs a criatura

Efecto The camarach uses Swallow Whole.

action->Project False Image.name: Project False Image
action->Project False Image.description: When the camarach casts project image, its illusory image can be another criatura of its size or a structure of its size that features a large portal (such as a freestanding archway or a large hut with an open doorway).

action->Swallow Whole.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.uJSseLa57HZYSMUu]

Huge, @Damage[(3d10+9)[bludgeoning]] daño, Rupture 34

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

Canopy Drop.name: Canopy Drop
Canopy Drop.description: A trapdoor, connected to floor sensors, opens in the section of floor marked on the map, while the surrounding floor suddenly tilts to a 45-degree angle and the fountains in the wall begin spraying at high pressure, making the tile slippery and pushing criaturas toward the open chute.
Canopy Drop.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:23|name:Jam Trapdoor Mechanism|traits:action:disable-a-device] (experto) to jam the mechanisms and keep the trapdoor from opening, or to locate the bypass switch hidden under a stair riser just outside the room

action->Flush.name: Flush
action->Flush.description:
Desencadenante Two or more criaturas stand on the trapped spaces

Efecto One round after the trap is triggered, all criaturas in the room fall 40 pies down the shaft to area E36, taking @Damage[20[bludgeoning]|options:fall-daño] daño from the fall plus @Damage[2d6[piercing]] daño as they land in the spiked pit.

The criaturas can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{GRAB an Edge} to snag the hammock or one of the hanging storage containers to avoid falling.

The DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{CLIMB} the walls or GRAB an Edge is 20.

Carvey.name: Carvey
Carvey.publicNotes: Made de odd scraps de piel y muscle, un flesh golem es un grotesque parody de life. Though ello tiene no mind, ello puede still go into un berserk rage cuando harmed, giving ello un faint semblance de emotion. Flesh golems guard el laboratories y charnel houses de fleshwarpers y necromancers who feel no compunctions about desecrating corpses for su own ends. Though el first flesh golem es believed a tienen been un misguided attempt a create de simple base elements, these monstrosities son far de human. In isolated cases, echoes de un personality might rise en un flesh golem si el brain used as part de su construction belonged a un particularly powerful personality, but such tragic instances son rare en el extreme.

action->Suicidal Obedience.name: Suicidal Obedience
action->Suicidal Obedience.description:
Carvey is unerringly loyal to the Skinsaw cult and to Mobana especially. When Carvey goes berserk, she doesn't attack the nearest living criatura or object but instead moves adjacent to the criatura nearest the balcony (or similar falling hazard, if the battle is taking place elsewhere) and attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} the criatura over the cliff's edge.

The number of pies Carvey can Shove a criatura is doubled as long as Carvey has 40 or fewer HP (thus, she pushes a criatura 10 pies on a sucessful check and 20 pies on a critical success), but she must move the same distance and in the same direction as the pushed criatura.

If the shoved criatura falls over the cliff's edge, so does Carvey.

action->Berserk.name: Berserk
action->Berserk.description:
A severely damaged flesh golem has a chance of going berserk.

If it has 40 or fewer HP at the start of its turn, the golem must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] check or go berserk. A berserk golem wildly attacks the nearest living criatura, or the nearest object if no criaturas are nearby.

action->Electric Reflexes.name: Electric Reflexes
action->Electric Reflexes.description:
Desencadenante The golem takes daño de electricidad and a criatura is adjacent to it.

Efecto The golem lashes out and tries to GRAB a nearby criatura. The golem attempts an ATHLETICS check to [[/act grapple]] an adjacent criatura. The criatura also takes @Damage[3d6[electricity]] daño on a success, or @Damage[6d6[electricity]] daño on a critical success.

action->Golem Antimagic.name: Golem Antimagic
action->Golem Antimagic.description:
harmed by fire ([[/r 5d8]], [[/r 3d4]] from areas or daño persistente); healed by electricity (area [[/r 2d4[healing]]] Puntos de Golpe); ralentizado by cold

A golem is immune to conjuros and magical abilities other than its own, but each type of golem is affected by a few types of magic in special ways. If an entry lists multiple types (such as "cold and water"), either type of conjuro can affect the golem.

Harmed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to take the listed amount of daño (this daño has no type) instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of magic of this type or is affected by a persistent effect of the appropriate type, it takes the daño listed in the parenthetical.

Healed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem makes the golem lose the ralentizado condition and gain HP equal to half the daño the conjuro would have dealt. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it gains the HP listed in the parenthetical.

Slowed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for [[/br 2d6 #rounds]]{2d6 rounds} instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for that round.

Vulnerable To Each golem is vulnerable to one or more specific conjuros, with the effects described in its stat block.

action->Vulnerable to Flesh to Stone.name: Vulnerable to Flesh to Stone
action->Vulnerable to Flesh to Stone.description: Casting a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.znv4ECL7ZtuiagtA]{Petrify} conjuro on the flesh golem affects the golem normally.

action->Berserk Slam.name: Berserk Slam
action->Berserk Slam.description:
Requisito The flesh golem is berserk.

Efecto The flesh golem Golpes with its fist at a -1 penalización de circunstancia. If it hits, it deals 1d6 daño adicional and knocks el objetivo @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

weapon->+1 Striking Sap.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.TLQErnOpM9Luy7rL]
+1 Striking Sap

armor->Chain Shirt.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.MPcM4Wt6KmWE2kGL]

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

action->Escort from the Premises.name: Escort from the Premises
action->Escort from the Premises.description:
Requisitos The casino bouncer has Grabbed a Medium or smaller target and is wielding a nonlethal arma in the other hand

Efecto The casino bouncer makes a Golpe against the grabbed target with the nonlethal arma. If the Golpe hits, it deals daño as usual and the casino bouncer moves el objetivo 5 pies (this is forced movement) and Steps into the space el objetivo had just occupied.

action->Intimidating Stare.name: Intimidating Stare
action->Intimidating Stare.description:
The casino bouncer attempts to [[/act demoralize]] a criatura with a mere glance. The casino bouncer doesn't take a penalización to their INTIMIDATION check if el objetivo doesn't speak the same language.

If the bouncer rolls a critical success, el objetivo can't reduce the value of its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado} condition until [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos} have passed.

Chalky.name: Chalky
Chalky.publicNotes: Este golem is a walking alchemical nightmare capable of inflicting all manner of painful wounds. Its ability to follow orders is granted by the otherwise mindless humanoid brain that floats in its dome-like head. In exceptionally rare cases, the brain used in its creation might retain fragments of memories or even actual intellect, resulting in an alchemical golem with a personality and agenda of its own.

action->Alchemical Chambers.name: Alchemical Chambers
action->Alchemical Chambers.description:
An alchemical golem's body contains six alchemical chambers filled with different substances. When an alchemical golem ability calls upon a randomly determined alchemical effect, roll 1d6 and consult the following :

[[/gmr 1d6 #Alchemical Efecto]] Alchemical Efecto
1

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.TZUskLT7yvP7N2co]{Elixir of Life (Lesser)}
2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.T4ouD4mVFHA3EHs6]{Bomber's Eye Elixir (Lesser)}
3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.oCuwJ9IUDAuzsUwa]{Bravo's Brew (Moderate)}
4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bQPRKEpnLakJBAAh]{Cat's Eye Elixir}
5 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.AqLxu3ir4UGzdOaz]{Cheetah's Elixir (Moderate)}
6 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.TMtQnY6yvIRCpK9v]{Juggernaut Mutagen (Greater)}

action->Alchemical Rupture.name: Alchemical Rupture
action->Alchemical Rupture.description:
When an alchemical golem takes daño físico from a impacto crítico or is affected by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1xbFBQDRs0hT5xZ9]{Shatter} conjuro, one glass chamber within its body shatters, spewing alchemical liquid in a @Template[emanation|distance:5].

Roll on the alchemical chambers list to determine which one shatters - all criaturas within a @Template[emanation|distance:5] are affected by the elixir in the randomly rolled alchemical chamber, and these criaturas may forego their Reflex saves against the effect if they wish.

action->Golem Antimagic.name: Golem Antimagic
action->Golem Antimagic.description:
harmed by sonic ([[/r 5d8]], [[/r 2d6]] from areas or daño persistente); healed by acid (area [[/r 2d4[healing]]] Puntos de Golpe); ralentizado by cold

A golem is immune to conjuros and magical abilities other than its own, but each type of golem is affected by a few types of magic in special ways. If an entry lists multiple types (such as "cold and water"), either type of conjuro can affect the golem.

Harmed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to take the listed amount of daño (this daño has no type) instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of magic of this type or is affected by a persistent effect of the appropriate type, it takes the daño listed in the parenthetical.

Healed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem makes the golem lose the ralentizado condition and gain HP equal to half the daño the conjuro would have dealt. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it gains the HP listed in the parenthetical.

Slowed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for [[/br 2d6 #rounds]]{2d6 rounds} instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for that round.

Vulnerable To Each golem is vulnerable to one or more specific conjuros, with the effects described in its stat block.

action->Vulnerable to Shatter.name: Vulnerable to Shatter
action->Vulnerable to Shatter.description: Casting a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1xbFBQDRs0hT5xZ9]{Shatter} conjuro on an alchemical golem affects the golem normally, but also causes an alchemical rupture.

action->Alchemical Injection.name: Alchemical Injection
action->Alchemical Injection.description:
When an alchemical golem hits a criatura with a syringe Golpe, roll 1d6 on the alchemical chambers list to determine the additional effect of the attack.

Chalky's alchemical chambers are filled with helpful potions and elixirs rather than harmful substances. When Chalky targets an ally with its syringe Golpe, the ally takes no daño and doesn't need to make a save against the rolled effect.

action->Adamantine Strikes.name: Adamantine Golpes
action->Adamantine Strikes.description: Chaos Gulgamodh's body—including the appendages it uses to make melee Golpes—is made of adamantine.

action->Cannon Fusillade.name: Cannon Fusillade
action->Cannon Fusillade.description:
Chaos Gulgamodh unleashes a salvo of explosive blasts in a @Template[cone|distance:30]. Las criaturas in the area take @Damage[(10d10+20)[fire]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:43|basic] salvación).

On a failed save, a criatura is subjected to a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.rollable-tables.RollTable.yRZwPolTnRdnz42V]{Warpwave} effect. On a critically failed save, a criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1}.

action->Efficient Winding.name: Efficient Winding
action->Efficient Winding.description:
For the clockwork amalgam to act, it must be wound with a unique key by another criatura. Este takes 1 minuto. Once wound, it remains operational for 7 days, after which time it becomes unaware of its surroundings and can't act until it's wound again.

The amalgam can enter standby mode as a 3-action activity. Its operational time doesn't decrease in standby, but it can sense its surroundings (with a -2 penalización to Perception). It can't act, with one exception: when it perceives a criatura, it can exit standby as a reaction (rolling initiative if appropriate).

A criatura can attempt a [[/act disable-device dc=33]]{DC 33 THIEVERY} check to Disable a Device to wind the amalgam down. For each success, the assassin loses 1 hora of operational time. Este can be done even if the amalgam is in standby mode.

action->Recalibrate.name: Recalibrate
action->Recalibrate.description: El clockwork amalgam puede recalibrate su internal structure a shed damaged components y replace them con nuevo ones, restoring @Damage[125[healing]] PG a el construct. Each time ello usa este ability, el clockwork amalgam permanently deactivates one de su five melee ataques as el components de que arm reassemble dentro de el core de el machine.

action->Whirring Doom.name: Whirring Doom
action->Whirring Doom.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

The clockwork amalgam becomes a blur of spinning weaponry. It makes up to five melee Golpes (one for each active melee attack it has available), taking a -4 penalización to the tirada de ataque for each attack, but ignoring the multiple attack penalización until it has made all of its attacks. It can use each melee attack only once and it can target each criatura in reach only once. If the clockwork amalgam used Whirring Doom in the previous round, it can use it again this round using only 1 action instead of 3. The amalgam's movement Velocidad is halved until the end of its next turn.

Clockwork Arms.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:43|name:Deactivate One Arm|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) to jam and deactivate one of the arms or @Check[athletics|dc:46|name:Tear Arm Off Machine] (legendario) to tear an arm off the machine.
Clockwork Arms.routine: (4 actions) La trampa loses 1 action per arm destroyed or disabled. On its turn, the trap makes claw Golpes against criaturas other than the Rumormonger or the Inkmaster. If an arm already has a criatura grabbed, the trap spends 2 actions to use its Open Hatch ability.

action->Bloody Chain Aura.name: Bloody Chain Aura
action->Bloody Chain Aura.description:
20 pies. Chains of blood bind a bleeding criatura to the Daemonic Skinner.

Las criaturas in range that are taking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistente Bleed Damage} can't move out of the aura.

The Skinner can have only one aura active at a time.

She can switch her active aura as an INTERACT action.

Desencadenante A criatura taking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistente Bleed Damage} within 30 pies of the Daemonic Skinner Casts a Spell with a verbal component or speaks

Efecto The Skinner wills the triggering criatura's blood to gush from their mouth and constrict their throat. El objetivo's conjuro is disrupted.

El objetivo must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:47] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2}.

action->Transfusion Aura.name: Transfusion Aura
action->Transfusion Aura.description:
30 pies. Any time a criatura in the aura takes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistente Bleed Damage}, the Daemonic Skinner regains the same number of Puntos de Golpe as the daño dealt.

The Skinner can have only one aura active at a time.

She can switch her active aura as an INTERACT action.

action->Hook and Flay.description:
Requisitos The Daemonic Skinner has a criatura grabbed with her blood chain or a criatura is affected by her bloody chain aura

Efecto The Skinner pulls the criatura into the nearest open adjacent square and makes a cleaver Golpe against the criatura.

Dart Barrage.name: Dart Barrage
Dart Barrage.description: Four dart-loaded pipes oculto en el diagonal muros son connected a un pressure plate under el brass seal en el sala's center.
Dart Barrage.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:22|name:Disable Pressure Plate|traits:action:disable-a-device] (entrenado) to disable the pressure plate, or four @Check[thievery|dc:18|name:Plug Dart Launcher|traits:action:disable-a-device] (entrenado) checks to plug the dart launchers
Dart Barrage.hpDetails: (UR 30) to destroy the seal and disable the trap
Dart Barrage.reset: La trampa runs out of darts after 4 asaltos of firing and must be reset manually by dismantling the walls to reload the launchers. If at any point there are no longer more than two criaturas placing weight on the floor, the trap ceases firing but remains armed, ready to resume firing its remaining darts once triggered again.
Dart Barrage.routine: (4 actions) La trampa loses 1 action for each disabled launcher. On each of the trap's actions, it fires one dart at a criatura in the center of the room.
Dart Barrage.stealth: (entrenado) or @Check[perception|dc:23|traits:action:seek] (entrenado) to notice scratches around the musical pipes and a slight give to the seal

Efecto La trampa makes up to four dart Golpes against criaturas standing on the seal, then rolls initiative.

A tanglefoot bag is filled with sticky substances. When tú hit a criatura with a tanglefoot bag, that criatura takes a -15-pies penalización de estado to its Velocidades for 1 minuto. Obtienes a +1 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque, and the Escape DC is 19.

On a impacto crítico, a criatura in contact with a solid surface becomes stuck to the surface and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} for 1 asalto, and a criatura flying via wings has its wings tangled, causing it to fall safely to the ground and become unable to Fly again for 1 asalto. Tanglefoot bags are not effective when used on a criatura that is in water.

El objetivo can end any effects by Escaping or spending a total of 3 actions to carefully remove the sticky substances. Estos INTERACT actions don't have to be consecutive, and other criaturas can provide the actions as well.

The conjuro must be of a conjuro rank the ammunition can hold, and the conjuro must be able to target a criatura other than the caster. A criatura hit by activated spellstrike ammunition is targeted by the conjuro. If the criatura isn't a valid target for the conjuro, the conjuro is lost.

The ammunition affects only el objetivo hit, even if the conjuro would normally affect more than one target. If the conjuro requires a conjuro tirada de ataque, use the result of tu ranged tirada de ataque with the ammunition to determine the degree of success of the conjuro. If the conjuro requires a tirada de salvación, el objetivo attempts the save against tu conjuro DC.

The maximum rank of conjuro the ammunition can hold determines its item level and Price.

action->Dreadsong.name: Dreadsong
action->Dreadsong.description:
The dreadsong dancer whirls their howling songblades and cloaks themself in illusion magic. Each non-fiend criatura in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] from the dreadsong dancer must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] salvación.

Éxito crítico No effect, and the criatura is temporarily immune for 24 horas. The dreadsong dancer is affected by their PERFORMANCE anxiety.

action->Vein Walker.description: El excorion mueve about by way de hundreds de pulsating sangre vessels, que stretch de su cuerpo en dozens de tight, ropy bundles y anchor ello a el suelo. Un excorion cannot be Tripped, Shoved, o otherwise forcibly moved except by magia, y el excorion ignora el terreno dificil (but no terreno dificil mayor).

action->Bloody Handprint.name: Bloody Handprint
action->Bloody Handprint.description: The excorion plants a magical handprint on el objetivo, marking them as chosen for death. The excorion makes a fist Golpe against an adjacent criatura; this does not count toward the excorion's multiple attack penalización. On a hit, the attack does no daño, but the criatura becomes observed to every excorion within 60 pies, even if an excorion's line of sight would be blocked by a wall or other obstacle. Este effect lasts until the handprint is washed off, which requires water and spending 3 actions to fully clean off.

Requisitos The excorion has at least 70 Puntos de Golpe

Efecto The excorion sacrifices itself and transfers its bloody, vital energy to a willing living criatura within 30 pies. The excorion is immediately destroyed, and the targeted living criatura heals a number of HP equal to half the excorion's remaining HP at the time that it used this ability.

The living criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} during its next turn as its body adjusts to the newly transfused blood and vital energy; the living criatura also counts as an excorion for 1 minuto for the purpose of seeing other excorions' Bloody Handprint marks.

Exploding Statue.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Safely Cut Wire|traits:action:disable-a-device] (entrenado) to safely cut the wire

action->Explosion.name: Explosión
action->Explosion.description:
Desencadenante A criatura opens the northern door without first disabling the trip wire

Efecto The statue explodes, spraying shrapnel to the west in a @Template[cone|distance:5] and dealing @Damage[(1d10+7)[piercing],1d10[fire]]{1d10+7 piercing and 1d10 fire} daño to all criaturas in the affected area (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic] salvación).

Explosive Barrels.name: Explosive Barrels
Explosive Barrels.description: Wooden barrels marked con un oil-drop symbol catch fuego y explode.
Explosive Barrels.disable: @Check[survival|dc:20|name:Smother the Flames] a smother el flames sin rupturing el barrels

action->Explode.name: Explotar
action->Explode.description:
Desencadenante 4 asaltos pass after the agents' arrival without anyone smothering them

Efecto The barrels explode, dealing @Damage[(3d6+8)[fire]] daño to everything within a 20-pies radius (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic|traits:fire] salvación).

Eyeball Tank.name: Eyeball Tank
Eyeball Tank.description: A vat of thick glass stands 10 pies high and is filled with green slime and fist-sized eyeballs.
Eyeball Tank.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:38|name:Acidify Slime|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) or @Check[crafting|dc:34|name:Acidify Slime] (experto) to acidify the slime inside the tank, destroying the eyeballs
Eyeball Tank.routine: (3 actions) Each round, the vat uses all three of its actions to shoot random eye rays at any living criaturas (except Ixusoth) in range.

action->Eye-Opener.name: Eye-Opener
action->Eye-Opener.description:
Desencadenante Three or more living criaturas remain within 20 pies of the trap for 1 asalto

Efecto La trampa rolls initiative.

action->Spill Eyeballs.name: Spill Eyeballs
action->Spill Eyeballs.description:
Desencadenante The tank reaches its Broken Threshold

Efecto The glass shatters, spilling eyeballs onto the floor in a @Template[emanation|distance:15]{15-pies radius} and casting grease (DC 33) on the affected area. The eyeball tank is permanently destroyed and can't be reset.Reset La trampa can be reset by adding 100 new eyeballs to the tank and allowing them to grow in the slime for 1 week.

False Door Trap.name: Trampa de puerta falsa
False Door Trap.description: Un oculto needle delivers un magico veneno a anyone trying a open el puerta.
False Door Trap.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:32|name:Jam Needle in Housing|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) to jam the needle in its housing or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (6th rank, counteract DC 30) to dispel the magical poison.

Este bit of jade is usually carved in the shape of a duelist, or sometimes a multi-armed criatura. When tú activate the bauble, it magically draws the attention of foes. Until the start of tu next turn, enemies within the reach of the arma the talisman is affixed to are desprevenido.

action->Nimble Dodge.name: Esquiva ágil
action->Nimble Dodge.description:
Desencadenante A criatura targets Fayati with an attack and she can see the attacker

Efecto Fayati dodges out of the way, gaining a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC against el ataque desencadenante.

action->Opportune Backstab.name: Puñalada trapera oportuna
action->Opportune Backstab.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within Fayati's reach is hit by a melee Golpe from one of her allies

Efecto Fayati makes a Golpe against the triggering criatura.

action->Deepen the Wound.name: Deepen the Wound
action->Deepen the Wound.description:
Requisitos Fayati's last attack was a successful melee Golpe with her rapier

Efecto Fayati makes a main-gauche Golpe against the same criatura that she just hit. Este Golpe deals an additional 4d6 daño de precisión.

action->Guildmaster's Lead.name: Guildmaster's Lead
action->Guildmaster's Lead.description:
Siempre que Fayati critically succeeds at a Golpe against a criatura, until the start of her next turn, the first time that another member of the Copper Hand deals daño to that criatura during their turn, they deal an additional 1d6 daño de precisión to it.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.dVVc5MYx4G3QPHoa]{Efecto: Guildmaster's Lead}

Field Of Opposition.name: Field Of Opposition
Field Of Opposition.description: Un distortion en espacio spawns un aggressive, malevolent shadow duplicate de cualquier characters who pass between Terimor's faces.
Field Of Opposition.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:42|name:Disable Thievery] (legendario) to permanently disable the planar distortion (DC increases by 2 for each duplicate still extant), or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (10th rank; counteract DC 42) to destroy the planar distortion

action->Spawn Mirror Duplicate.name: Spawn Mirror Duplicate
action->Spawn Mirror Duplicate.description:
Desencadenante A criatura moves between the two glass faces of Olansa Terimor

Efecto The planar rift disgorges an evil mirror duplicate of the criatura, and the duplicate rolls initiative.

The field of opposition can use this reaction una vez por asalto but can't spawn a duplicate of a criatura that already has a mirror duplicate in existence.

action->Mirror Duplicate.name: Mirror Duplicate
action->Mirror Duplicate.description:
A mirror duplicate rolls initiative with a +45 modifier. It uses the same statistics as the original criatura, but with a +2 bonificador de estado to AC, attacks, and tiradas de salvación. The duplicate is evil, and any abilities reliant on alignment change accordingly. The duplicate is also aggressive, attacking and taking other hostile actions available to it against anyone other than mirror duplicates.

It has three actions and one reaction and can use any of the original criatura's abilities. Any limited-use abilities (such as conjuro slots) are based on what the original had when duplicated and are used up separately from the original criatura's. The duplicate also has duplicates of the criatura's worn and held items, but not consumables.

A duplicate is destroyed when reduced to 0 HP, when the trap is disabled or destroyed, or when the duplicate leaves area E2. Its duplicated items disappear when they leave its grip, though they last long enough for ranged Golpes.

Flying Guillotine.name: Flying Guillotine
Flying Guillotine.description: An invisible magical glyph on the guillotine's blade detects living criaturas in the room, which causes the guillotine to fly off its hinges and attack.
Flying Guillotine.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Erase Glyph|traits:action:disable-a-device] (entrenado) to erase the glyph (which requires a successful unarmed tirada de ataque if the blade is already active) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (3rd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract it. La trampa has a secret bypass known only to Ralso and Pratchett: as long as the guillotine can see a criatura in the room touching thumb and pinky together with an empty hand, it remains dormant.
Flying Guillotine.reset: After 1 minuto, the trap deactivates, though the door remains locked. La trampa rearms itself each day at dawn.
Flying Guillotine.routine: (1 action) The blade @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cS9nfDRGD83bNU1p]{Flies} up to 20 pies and Golpes any criaturas whose squares it passes through. It cannot target the same criatura more than una vez por asalto. The blade cannot be grappled and doesn't take a multiple attack penalización.

action->Flying Blade.name: Hoja voladora
action->Flying Blade.description:
Desencadenante A living criatura enters the room

Efecto One round after a criatura enters the room, the door to the room slams shut and locks (two [[/act pick-a-lock dc=20]]{THIEVERY} checks to pick), and the guillotine blade detaches from its housing and begins flying around the room as the trap rolls initiative.

When Forcing Open an object that doesn't have an easy grip, a crowbar makes it easier to gain the necessary leverage. Without a crowbar, prying something open takes a -2 penalización por objeto to the ATHLETICS check to FORCE OPEN (similar to using a shoddy item).

Puedes throw a grappling hook with a rope tied to it to make a CLIMB easier. To anchor a grappling hook, make an tirada de ataque with the secret rasgo against a DC depending on el objetivo, typically at least DC 20. On a success, tu hook has a firm hold, but on a critical failure, the hook seems like it will hold but actually falls when estás partway up.

Necesitas thieves' tools to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the THIEVERY skill. Infiltrator thieves' tools add a +1 bonificador por objeto to checks to Pick Locks and Disable Devices.

If tu thieves' tools are broken, puedes REPAIR them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.BznmPaRjI4Orb0IH]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to tu tools; this doesn't require using the REPAIR action. action->Deflective Dodge.description:
Desencadenante The tirada de ataque for a Golpe targeting Franca fails or critically fails

Efecto Franca can elige to either Dar un paso or redirect the attack to a criatura that is adjacent to her and within the reach of el ataque desencadenante.

The attacker rerolls the Golpe's tirada de ataque against the new target.

action->Bloody Rebel.name: Bloody Rebel
action->Bloody Rebel.description:
Franca quickly slashes at nearby foes, aiming to maim rather than disable. She makes up to three melee Golpes, each against a different criatura within reach.

Estos Golpes count toward Franca's multiple attack penalización, but the penalización doesn't increase until after all three Golpes are made.

On a hit, the Golpe deals @Damage[3[bleed]] daño instead of its normal daño.

On a impacto crítico, the criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} until the beginning of Franca's next turn or until they spend an action to remove the condition, whichever comes first.

action->Hamstring.name: Hamstring
action->Hamstring.description:
Requisitos Franca's last action was a melee Golpe that dealt sneak attack daño to an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} target

Efecto Franca deals @Damage[6[bleed]] daño to el objetivo criatura, and el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1}.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

Franca's Golpes deal an additional 3d6 daño de precisión to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

action->Splash Poison.name: Splash Poison
action->Splash Poison.description:
Franca uncorks and flings a dose of poison at a bleeding foe.

She retrieves a poison from her inventory, then splashes it at a criatura within 10 pies that is currently taking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistente Bleed Damage}.

The criatura must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:32] salvación or be exposed to the poison.

Freezing Alarm.name: Freezing Alarm
Freezing Alarm.description: Miniature snowflake-shaped glyphs en el suelo cause un layer de hielo a ripple over el suelo de el sala y sound un silent alarm.
Freezing Alarm.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:53|name:Disable Arcana] (legendario) to draw a fiery counteracting glyph over each snowflake, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank, counteract DC 48)

action->Freeze Floor.name: Freeze Floor
action->Freeze Floor.description:
Desencadenante A criatura enters one of the three squares marked with a T on the map

Efecto The floor of the entire 10-pies-by-15-pies antechamber freezes over, sending deadly magical frost creeping up the legs of the intruders. Any criaturas standing in the room must roll a @Check[reflex|dc:45] salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura takes @Damage[(3d10+5)[cold]] daño.

Fallo The criatura takes @Damage[(6d10+10)[cold]] daño and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos}.

Fallo crítico The criatura takes @Damage[(12d10+20)[cold]] daño and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for 1 minuto.

Additionally, the golems in area B10 become aware of the intruders. The golems activate and come to this room to attack, if they haven't been destroyed already.

action->Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenecimiento
action->Rejuvenation.description:
Cuando Frefferth es destruido, su cuerpo y objetos dissipate into shadowy nothingness y el knight re-forms after [[/gmr 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days} dentro de el sarcophagus en area D12, fully healed.

Frefferth puede be trapped solo by returning el @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.6MIBHKMJmD8uQVam]{Chain de el Stilled espiritual} a el sarcophagus (see areas D12 y D34), en que case Frefferth's cuerpo dissipates, leaving su objetos en el spot where el fue last slain.

action->Head Hunter.name: Head Hunter
action->Head Hunter.description:
Any slashing arma a dullahan wields becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.hg3IogR8ue2IWwgS]{Keen}, and any hatchet it wields becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qlunQzfnzPQpMG6U]{Returning}.

If the dullahan kills a criatura with a impacto crítico using a slashing arma, el objetivo is decapitated as though the dullahan had used Reap on el objetivo.

Estos effects remain only while the dullahan holds the arma.

action->Impaler.name: Impaler
action->Impaler.description:
Siempre que Frefferth damages a criatura with a impacto crítico using a ranged piercing arma, the arma remains impaled in the victim's body.

The victim becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1} as long as they are impaled; the impaling arma can be removed by the affected criatura or an adjacent ally as a 2-action activity that has the manipulate rasgo.

action->Reap.name: Reap
action->Reap.description:
Frefferth removes the head of a dead criatura within reach.

Each criatura within the area of Frefferth's frightful presence must attempt a new save, even if they are temporarily immune.

action->Summon Steed.name: Summon Steed
action->Summon Steed.description:
Frefferth summons a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.qRUqoezeEnQ2KdyT]{Nightmare}.

Este steed remains until it is slain, Frefferth @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AjLSHZSWQ90exdLo]{Dismisses} it, or Frefferth summons another steed.

action->Charming Liar.name: Mentiroso encantador
action->Charming Liar.description:
When Gage gets a critical success using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} action, el objetivo's attitude toward him improves by one step, as though he'd succeeded at using DIPLOMACY to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}.

Este works only once per conversation, and if he critically succeeds against multiple targets using the same result, he chooses one criatura's attitude to improve.

To use this ability, Gage must be lying to impart seemingly important information, inflate his status, or ingratiate himself, which trivial or irrelevant lies can't achieve.

action->Smooth Operator.name: Smooth Operator
action->Smooth Operator.description:
When Gage meets a group of up to five people, he can immediately attempt a DIPLOMACY check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, comparing the result to the Will DC of each target.

He takes a -3 penalización on this check, and it is possible to get different degrees of success for each target. If he fails or critically fails, he can engage in 1 minuto of conversation and attempt a new check at the end of that time rather than accepting the failure or critical failure result.

action->Bullyrag Beatdown.name: Bullyrag Beatdown
action->Bullyrag Beatdown.description: Siempre que the gang tough makes a successful melee Golpe against a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado} criatura, the Golpe deals an extra arma die of daño.

action->Frightening Critical.name: Crítico aterrador
action->Frightening Critical.description: When the gang tough's Golpe with a bludgeoning arma is a impacto crítico and deals daño, el objetivo queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}.

ammo->Bolts.name: Virotes
ammo->Bolts.description: Mas cortos que las flechas tradicionales pero de construccion similar, los virotes son la municion que usan las ballestas.

action->Sidestep.name: Paso lateral
action->Sidestep.description:
Desencadenante The tirada de ataque for a Golpe targeting the assassin fails or critically fails

Efecto The assassin deftly steps out of the way of the attack. If there's another criatura adjacent to the assassin and within reach of el ataque desencadenante, the assassin redirects the attack to that adjacent criatura. The attacker then rerolls the Golpe's tirada de ataque against the new target.

action->Point Blank.name: Point Blank
action->Point Blank.description: The maestro assassin makes a crossbow Golpe against an adjacent enemigo; unlike most ranged Golpes, this Golpe doesn't provoke reactions. If successful, the attack deals an additional 4d8 daño de precisión.

action->Running Reload.name: Recarga a la carrera
action->Running Reload.description: The maestro assassin Strides, Steps, or Sneaks, then Interacts to reload her crossbow.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

The maestro assassin deals an additional 3d6 daño de precisión to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

action->Study Target.name: Study Target
action->Study Target.description: The maestro assassin observes a single target she can see, allowing her to use her Vorpal Garrote during the next round.

action->Vorpal Garrote.name: Vorpal Garrote
action->Vorpal Garrote.description:
Requisitos The maestro assassin used Study Target during the previous round and must have a garrote bolt

Efecto The maestro assassin makes a crossbow Golpe against el objetivo she previously studied. If she rolls a success on her tirada de ataque, she gets a critical success instead. El objetivo must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:36|traits:damaging-effect] salvación.

Éxito No additional effect.

Fallo El objetivo takes an additional 3d12 daño de precisión.

Fallo crítico El objetivo is decapitated and instantly dies unless it doesn't require a head to live.

Gas Trap.name: Gas Trap
Gas Trap.description: Un spring slams y locks el sala's puerta before four oculto gas vents begin pumping veneno gas into el camara.
Gas Trap.disable: Four @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Block Gas Vents|traits:action:disable-a-device] pruebas a block el gas vents, o un @Check[thievery|dc:26|name:Unlock Door|traits:action:pick-a-lock] prueba a unlock el puerta y escapar
Gas Trap.reset: La trampa must be manually rearmed by unblocking the vents or replacing the poison gas tank in area E30.
Gas Trap.routine:
(1 action) Each round on its initiative count, the trap pumps more toxic gas into the room.

Any breathing criatura in the room takes @Damage[4d6[poison]] daño (a successful @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:poison,damaging-effect] salvación halves the daño taken). If a criatura acts before the trap on the first round, it has the option of holding its breath to postpone taking daño from the trap-holding one's breath after the trap's first action has no effect, since the air in the criatura's lungs is already tainted. Locating and blocking one of the hidden gas vents reduces the daño de veneno by 1d6-if all four are blocked, the trap is disabled, though the door remains locked. Otherwise, the trap functions for 1 minuto before all the gas is expended and characters in the room cease taking daño, after which the trap ventilates the room for 1 additional minute.
Gas Trap.stealth: (entrenado) to smell the poison gas or hear it hissing

action->Toxic Gas.name: Toxic Gas
action->Toxic Gas.description:
Desencadenante A criatura opens one of the drawers

Efecto The door to the room slams shut and locks and the trap rolls initiative. (La trampa can also be triggered manually or disarmed from area E30.)

spell->Dancing Lights.description: Creas up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 pies apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When tú Sustain the Spell, puedes move any number of lights up to 60 pies. Each light must remain within 120 pies of tú and within 10 pies of all others, or it winks out.

action->Free Blade.name: Free Blade
action->Free Blade.description:
Desencadenante The ghaele ends its turn while unable to act or attempts a greatsword Golpe that would take a circumstance or penalización de estado.

Efecto A ghaele's blade is implacable in the pursuit of freedom, and its energies can overpower any effect that would interfere with its swordplay.

The ghaele attempts to counteract each effect that prevents it from making a greatsword Golpe, gives it a penalización to its greatsword Golpe, or prevents it from acting.

The ghaele can use this ability even if it's otherwise unable to act.

action->Light Form.name: Light Form
action->Light Form.description:
A ghaele's body is partially corporeal and partially composed of light, with a color corresponding to the elemental energy currently residing in its blade (see Elige Weakness).

It can move through solid objects but can't end its action within a solid object.

action->Choose Weakness.name: Elige Weakness
action->Choose Weakness.description:
A ghaele attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a foe they are facing.

If successful, they can change the elemental daño dealt by their greatsword and light ray to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic, usually to match the foe's weakness.

They can also change their energy resistance to any of these energy types (this can be a different type than for their attacks).

The choices remain until they next use Elige Weakness.

action->Ghaele's Gaze.name: Ghaele's Gaze
action->Ghaele's Gaze.description:
When a ghaele fixes their gaze upon a non-good criatura, the criatura is subjected to the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sX2o0HH4RjJDAZ8C]{Divine Decree} (@Check[will|dc:20|name:Divine Decree|traits:damaging-effect] salvación).

If it survives, the criatura is temporarily immune to for 1 minuto.

action->Greater Holy Blade.name: Greater Holy Blade
action->Greater Holy Blade.description: Any arma becomes a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.rvItjGQaYT7Luwtm]{+3} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DH0kB9Wbr5pDeunX]{Holy} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.KCQRFvUgbyclvOGi]{Greater Striking} arma while the ghaele wields it.

action->Bonesense (Imprecise) 30 feet.name: Bonesense (Imprecise) 30 pies
action->Bonesense (Imprecise) 30 feet.description: A giant bone skipper identifies bones and criaturas with a skeletal system in the listed range.

action->Leaping Charge.name: Leaping Charge
action->Leaping Charge.description: The giant bone skipper @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leaps} up to 20 pies. It then makes a mandibles Golpe, gaining a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to its tirada de ataque.

action->Marrow Rot.name: Marrow Rot
action->Marrow Rot.description:
Marrow rot affects only criaturas with a skeletal system

Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:25|traits:disease]

Onset 1 día

Etapa 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} (1 día)

Etapa 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2} (1 día)

Etapa 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1} (1 día)

action->Joro Spider Venom.name: Joro Spider Venom
action->Joro Spider Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:25]

Duración máxima 6 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[1d8[poison]] (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[1d8[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 @Damage[1d8[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 2} (1 asalto)

Etapa 4 @Damage[2d8[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} ([[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos})

action->Web Trap.name: Web Trap
action->Web Trap.description: A criatura hit by the joro spider's web Golpe is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and stuck to the nearest surface until it [[/act escape dc=25]]{Escapes}.

action->Hypnotic Glow.name: Hypnotic Glow
action->Hypnotic Glow.description: 30 pies. Similar to other will-o'-wisps, a gloaming will-o'-wisp is naturally invisible, but glows with a faint colored light. They cast dim light in the aura, which makes them visible. In addition, any non-aberration criatura that ends their turn in the aura and can see the gloaming will-o'-wisp is distracted by the gloaming will-o'-wisp's glow and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:31] salvación. On a failure, the criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} for 1 asalto and takes @Damage[3d6[mental]] daño.

action->Magic Immunity.name: Magic Immunity
action->Magic Immunity.description: A will-o'-wisp is immune to all conjuros except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HRb2doyaLtaoCfi3]{Faerie Fire}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{Quandary}.

action->Feed on Fear.name: Feed on Fear
action->Feed on Fear.description:
Requisito Un enemigo is under a fear effect or dying within 15 pies of the will-o'-wisp

Efecto The will-o'-wisp feeds on the criatura's terror. They regains 4d8 Puntos de Golpe, and if they've Gone Dark, their glow reignites. A will-o'-wisp can take this action only una vez por asalto.

action->Go Dark.name: Go Dark
action->Go Dark.description: The gloaming will-o'-wisp extinguishes their hypnotic glow, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. They can end this effect with another use of this action. If they use their shock attack while invisible, the arc of electricity lets any observer determine their location, making the will-o'-wisp only @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido} to observers until they move.
