action->Drain Bonded Item.description:
Frecuencia 7 times per day

Requisitos Grabble hasn't acted yet on this turn

Efecto Grabble can cast one prepared conjuro he has already cast today without spending a conjuro slot. He must still Lanzar el conjuro and meet the conjuro's other requirements. He can do this una vez al día for each of the conjuro ranks he can cast.

action->Poison Conversion.name: Poison Conversion
action->Poison Conversion.description:
Frecuencia 3 times per day

Efecto If Grabble's next action is to cast a cantrip or a conjuro that is 6th rank or lower and deals acid, cold, electricity, or daño de fuego, the conjuro deals daño de veneno rather than its normal tipo de daño and gains the poison rasgo.

action->Planar Coven.name: Planar Coven
action->Planar Coven.description: As long as at least one other member of Myrna's coven is on the demiplane of Stormholt, the coven members add chain lightning, lightning bolt, plane shift, and punishing winds to their conjuros, each of which can be cast at up to 8th level.

action->Sea Hag's Bargain.name: Sea Hag's Bargain
action->Sea Hag's Bargain.description: The sea hag can make a bargain with a willing criatura, who must be of sound mind. The criatura gives away a special or cherished quality-such as its courage, its beauty, or its voice-in exchange for a boon or a promise from the sea hag. As long as the sea hag keeps her end of the bargain, the only way to restore the lost quality is to defeat the sea hag or make another bargain for its return.

action->Dread Gaze.name: Dread Gaze
action->Dread Gaze.description:
The hag gazes upon a criatura, afflicting it with intense distress and a gnawing sense of impending doom, with a result depending on its Will save (DC 37). El objetivo does not need to be able to see the sea hag.

Éxito crítico No effect.

Éxito @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}.

Fallo @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for 1 asalto. If el objetivo was dying, it remains unconscious for 1 día. At the end of the day, it must attempt a Fortitude save against the same DC; if it fails, it dies.

Fallo crítico @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for 1 minuto. If el objetivo was dying, it remains unconscious for 1 día. At the end of the day, it must attempt a Fortitude save against the same DC; if it fails, it dies.

action->Pull Under.name: Pull Under
action->Pull Under.description:
Requisitos A criatura within 60 pies of Graem or Grinlowe is in contact with the waters of Stormholt

Efecto The hag casts maze (DC 37) on the criatura, magically pulling the criatura beneath the water (regardless of its actual depth) into an extradimensional underwater maze of shipwrecks. Between the two of them, Graem and Grinlowe can have only one criatura trapped in the maze, but either hag can use the Sustain a Spell action to sustain the effect.

action->Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenecimiento
action->Rejuvenation.description:
Cuando un graveknight es destruido, su armadura rebuilds su cuerpo over el course de [[/gmr 1d10 #days]] dias-o more quickly si el armadura es worn by un vivo host. Si el cuerpo es destruido before then, el process restarts.

Un graveknight puede solo be permanently destruido by obliterating su armadura (such as con @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}), transporting ello a el Forge de Creation, o throwing ello into el heart de un volcano.

action->Sacrilegious Aura.name: Sacrilegious Aura
action->Sacrilegious Aura.description: 30 pies. When a criatura in the aura uses a vitality conjuro or ability, the graveknight automatically attempts to counteract it, with a +27 counteract modifier.

action->Devastating Blast.name: Devastating Blast
action->Devastating Blast.description:
The graveknight unleashes a @Template[cone|distance:30] of energy.

Las criaturas in the area take @Damage[10d12[fire]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:37|basic|options:area-effect] salvación).

The graveknight can't use this ability again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Devastating Blast]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Graveknight's Curse.name: Graveknight's Curse
action->Graveknight's Curse.description:
Este curse affects anyone who wears a graveknight's armor for at least 1 hora

Tirada de salvación @Check[will|dc:43|traits:curse] salvación

Onset 1 hora

Etapa 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Condenado 1} and can't remove the armor (1 día)

Etapa 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Condenado 2}, hampered 10, and can't remove the armor (1 día)

Etapa 3 dies and transforms into the armor's graveknight

action->Kharnas's Blessing.name: Kharnas's Blessing
action->Kharnas's Blessing.description:
The graveknight carves the sigil of Kharnas onto an adjacent @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Inconsciente} criatura.

As long as the criatura bears the sigil of Kharnas, it takes a -2 penalización de estado to tiradas de salvación against the abilities of any criatura that previously served Kharnas, but it can also freely pass through any hazards that can be bypassed by those bearing the sigil of Kharnas, such as Kharnas's glyphs.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.St2QzqQvKN0IaXxG]{Efecto: Kharna's Blessing}

action->Weapon Master.name: Maestro de armas
action->Weapon Master.description: The graveknight has access to the critical specialization effects of any armas it wields.

Greater Planar Rift.name: Greater Planar Rift
Greater Planar Rift.description: A ragged planar rift drags things into its depths and hurls criaturas through from its terminal end.
Greater Planar Rift.disable: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel magia} (9th rank; counteract DC 46) a seal el rift

action->Greater Planar Rift.name: Greater Planar Rift
action->Greater Planar Rift.description:
Desencadenante A criatura moves within 5 pies of the rift

Efecto The criatura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:44] salvación or be drawn into the rift. A criatura so drawn in becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 3} and immediately teleports to a different random area in Kharnas's ruins.

consumable->Snake Oil.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.xBZCVHAa1SnR8Xul]

Activar A INTERACT

Puedes apply snake oil onto a wound or other outward symptom of an affliction or condition (such as sores from a disease or discoloration from a poison). For the next hour, the symptom disappears and the wounded or afflicted criatura doesn't feel as if it still has the wound or affliction, though all effects remain. Grunka.name: Grunka
Grunka.publicNotes:
The frontline fighters of goblin tribes prefer to fight in large groups-especially when they can outnumber their foes at least three to one.

Estos small humanoids have green or gray skin and large heads with wide ears. While some goblins are civilized and have worked hard to be considered upstanding members of humanoid communities, most are impetuous and vicious criaturas who delight in wreaking havoc. Estos goblins think nothing of slaughtering livestock, stealing infants, or burning down a building purely for momentary delight. They revel in playing malicious tricks on taller humanoids, whom they call "longshanks."

Goblins are superstitious, with an intense awe of magic and a fascination with fire; goblins who maestro magic or fire earn great respect from their kin. Most other humanoids find it difficult to understand goblins' outlook: they hate canines but eagerly share their lairs with so-called "goblin dogs," they fearlessly attack larger criaturas but are terrified of horses, and they despise vegetables yet consider pickles a delicacy. To a goblin, of course, these are all perfectly sensible life choices.

Desencadenante A criatura attempts to target the hundun with a mental effect

Efecto The triggering criatura is subject to the utter chaos of the hundun's mind and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:40|traits:damaging-effect] salvación.

Fallo crítico As failure, but the criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 2}.

action->Activate Attractor.name: Activar Attractor
action->Activate Attractor.description:
The hundun releases its staff-like attractor, which hovers in place. The hundun can use an action, which has the concentrate rasgo, to move the attractor up to 60 pies, to a maximum of 300 pies from the hundun. It can also use an action, which has the concentrate rasgo, to recall the attractor, which flies to the hundun and immediately deactivates.

Las criaturas within 40 pies of the attractor must attempt a @Check[will|dc:40|name:Attractor] salvación if they're within the area when the attractor is activated or as soon as they enter the area while it's active. Once a criatura has attempted the save, it uses the same result for the rest of that activation of the attractor.

Any restrictions on a criatura's movement apply only if it voluntarily moves away from the attractor. For example, if the attractor moves closer to a criatura, the criatura doesn't then need to move away.

Chaotic criaturas are immune to the effects of the attractor.

The attractor can't be harmed by physical attacks but is destroyed by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ihbRf964JDXztcy3]{Disjunction}, a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.HuGZspUvJqR09Y8u]{Rod of Cancellation}, a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.B4DnQNcGl6nFVKHl]{Sphere of Annihilation}, and other similarly powerful effects.

The attractor has an AC of 40 and a counteract DC of 37. A hundun can rebuild a destroyed attractor after [[/gmr 1d8 #hours]]{1d8 hours} of uninterrupted meditation. If the hundun is slain, its attractor disappears.

Éxito crítico The criatura's movement isn't restricted.

Éxito The criatura treats each square in the area as difficult terrain when moving away from the attractor.

Fallo The criatura can't move away from the attractor within the area.

Ink Drowning Vats.name: Ink Drowning Vats
Ink Drowning Vats.description: Steel hatch doors automatically lock shut in each of the four vats labeled J2. Four ink spouts (one per vat) jut through a narrow aperture in the ceiling of each vat, 20 pies above.
Ink Drowning Vats.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:40|name:Seal an Ink Spout|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) to seal an ink spout, @Check[thievery|dc:48|name:Unlock a Door|traits:action:pick-a-lock] (maestro) to unlock a steel hatch door, or @Check[athletics|dc:45|name:Force Open a Door|traits:action:force-open] (maestro) to FORCE OPEN a steel hatch door
Ink Drowning Vats.reset: La trampa can be reset by refilling the ink storage tanks above the vats.
Ink Drowning Vats.routine: (4 actions) La trampa loses 1 action for each disabled ink spout. On each of the trap's actions, a spout pours ink, increasing the depth of the ink in that vat by 2 pies. Las criaturas standing in the ink are exposed to a dose of poison ink. Once the vat is full of ink, the trap stops using actions, but criaturas in the vat might start drowning.

action->Fill Tank.name: Fill Tank

@Check[athletics|dc:48|name:Disable Athletics] (legendario) or @Check[acrobatics|dc:45|name:Disable Acrobatics] (maestro) to tie one tentacle into a knot, rendering it useless, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (8th rank; counteract DC 44) to counteract one tentacle.

The death of the Daemonic Rumormonger permanently dispels all the inky tendrils.
Inky Tendrils.routine: (6 actions) The hazard loses 1 action for every tentacle that is disabled or destroyed. The tentacles can combine their actions to use the hazard's Inky Imitator ability. A broken tentacle can still Golpe, but it can't GRAB. Este hazard takes no multiple attack penalización.

action->Black Ink Delirium.description:

Etapa 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[6d6[poison]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confundido} (1 asalto)

action->Inky Imitator.name: Inky Imitator
action->Inky Imitator.description:
The inky tendrils cast a 10th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.73rToy0v5Ra9NvL6]{Duplicate Foe} conjuro (@Check[fortitude|dc:40|name:Duplicate Foe]) on el objetivo; on a failed save, a simulacrum of el objetivo made from dripping ink and clockwork scraps emerges from any other spot (tendrils' choice) in the lake.

The tendrils don't need to Sustain the Spell; the duplicate exists for 1 minuto or until it is destroyed before collapsing into a puddle of ink and scrap metal.

action->Slam Shut.description:
Desencadenante A criatura steps onto the trap's pressure plate (indicated on the map)

The triggering criatura takes @Damage[(4d10+10)[piercing],2d6[bleed]]{4d10+10 daño perforante and 2d6 daño persistente de sangrado} (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|options:inflicts:immobilized] salvación; if the criatura critically succeeds, they avoid the trap completely). The triggering criatura is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. The victim can end their immobilization only once a criatura outside the iron maiden unlocks the device (requiring two successful DC 28 THIEVERY checks to [[/act disable-device dc=28]]) or breaks the iron maiden, after which the trapped criatura must succeed at a DC 25 check to [[/act escape dc=25]] the trap's spike-lined interior.

equipment->Robe of Eyes.description:
Este garment appears to be an ordinary robe until donned, at which point numerous strange and alien eyes of varied shapes and colors open and blink across its fabric. While wearing the robe, obtienes a +3 bonificador por objeto to Perception checks, and tú constantly benefit from the effects of a 2nd-rank see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} conjuro.

Puedes also see powerful magic auras. The highest-level magic aura within 30 pies of tú glows in a color that reveals its school to tú and allows tú to determine where the effect originates. Este can narrow down the origin point of the effect to a 5-pies-cube, but not more precisely than that.

The robe of eyes is not without its dangers. If any conjuro with the light rasgo is cast on tú or tu square while estás wearing the robe, estás blinded for a number of rounds equal to the conjuro's rank unless tú succeed at a Fortitude save against the conjuro's DC.

Activar A INTERACT

Efecto Tú pluck an eye from the robe and toss it into the air, where it turns invisible and floats to a destination tú elige, with the same effect as a 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ek5XI0aEdZhBgm21]{Scouting Eye} conjuro. Puedes Sustain the Activation just as tú would be able to Sustain the Spell.

action->Lore Master.name: Lore Master
action->Lore Master.description: Ixusoth retains a vast amount of knowledge. She can use her Bardic LORE skill to Recall Knowledge on any topic, and she knows any languages common to an area she has spent a day or more in.

action->Eye Probe.name: Eye Probe
action->Eye Probe.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Up to six of Ixusoth's eyes detach from her body. Each eye has AC 26, HP 1, and a fly speed of 40 pies. Ixusoth can see through all of her eye probes. She can move the probes all in separate directions using a single action. Ixusoth can have no more than six eye probes active at a time; using this ability to create more eyes causes the eye or eyes farthest away to shrivel and die.

Ixusoth can deliver touch conjuros through her eye probes and make melee conjuro attacks through them. In addition, she can Steal Memories through an eye probe using a single action by touching el objetivo with the eye.

action->Scatterbrain Palm.name: Scatterbrain Palm
action->Scatterbrain Palm.description:
A criatura hit by Ixusoth's fist Golpe must attempt a @Check[will|dc:36|options:inflicts:aturdido] salvación. The criatura is then temporarily immune until the start of its next turn.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Fallo crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}, and the hyakume can use Steal Memories on el objetivo as part of this action.

action->Steal Memories.name: Steal Memories
action->Steal Memories.description: Ixusoth reaches out with her mind and attempts to steal memories from a criatura within 30 pies. El objetivo must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:40] tirada de salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} and have some of its memories stolen. When Ixusoth steals memories, she learns some of the criatura's memories (chosen by the GM). Estos memories are then lost to that criatura.

Algunos lanzadores de conjuros divinos, como los clérigos, pueden utilizar un símbolo religioso de su dios como foco divino para utilizar ciertas habilidades y lanzar algunos conjuros. Se debe sostener un símbolo religioso en una mano para usarlo.

action->Call Toxins.name: Call Toxins
action->Call Toxins.description: 30 pies. Flakfatter exudes an aura that makes poisons more potent. His melee Golpes deal an additional @Damage[2d8[persistent,poison]]. Las criaturas in the aura attempting a prueba plana to remove daño persistente de veneno must roll twice and take the lower result. Flakfatter can suppress or resume this aura as a free action.

action->Infector.name: Infector
action->Infector.description: Flakfatter targets a criatura within 30 pies that's currently subject to a poison affliction. The poison affliction progresses to the next stage.

action->Steady Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros firme
action->Steady Spellcasting.description: Si un reaction would disrupt Flakfatter's spellcasting action, el attempts un @Check[flat|dc:15] prueba. con un exito, el action isn't disrupted.

equipment->Bracers of Armor II.name: Bracers of Armor II
equipment->Bracers of Armor II.description: Estos stiff leather armguards grant tú a +2 bonificador por objeto to AC and tiradas de salvación, and a maximum Dexterity modifier of +5. Puedes affix talismans to bracers of armor as though they were light armor.

equipment->Disguise Kit (Elite).description: Este small wooden box contains cosmetics, false facial hair, spirit gum, and a few simple wigs. Tú usually need a disguise kit to set up a disguise in order to Impersonate someone using the DECEPTION skill. An elite disguise kit adds a +1 bonificador por objeto to relevant checks. If has crafted a large number of disguises, puedes replenish tu cosmetics supply with replacement cosmetics suitable for the type of tu disguise kit.

consumable->Healing Potion (Moderate).description: A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When tú drink a healing potion, tú regain @Damage[(3d8+10)[healing]] Puntos de Golpe.

consumable->Snake Oil.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.xBZCVHAa1SnR8Xul]

Activar A INTERACT

Puedes apply snake oil onto a wound or other outward symptom of an affliction or condition (such as sores from a disease or discoloration from a poison). For the next hour, the symptom disappears and the wounded or afflicted criatura doesn't feel as if it still has the wound or affliction, though all effects remain. A criatura can uncover the ruse by succeeding at a @Check[perception|dc:17|traits:action:seek] check, but only if it uses a Seek action to specifically examine the snake oil's effects.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ylUdMTsfOQGJ3MN3]

An alchemical substance applied to one end of this tiny wooden stick ignites when struck against a rough surface. Creating a flame with a tindertwig is much faster than creating a flame with flint and steel. Puedes ignite the tindertwig and touch it to a flammable object as part of the same INTERACT action.

action->Cheek Pouches.name: Bolsas para las mejillas
action->Cheek Pouches.description: A ratfolk has stretchy cheek pouches that can store up to 1 cubic pies of objects. The ratfolk can remove or store an item using the INTERACT action. As long as the ratfolk has at least one object in its cheek pouches, its speech is noticeably difficult to understand.

action->Katar Specialist.name: Katar Specialist
action->Katar Specialist.description: Kekker has entrenado extensively with the katar blade. Any katar he wields gains the finesse rasgo.

action->Quick Stow.name: Quick Stow
action->Quick Stow.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto.

Efecto Kekker stores one held item of light or negligible Bulk in his cheek pouches.

action->Swarming.name: enjambre
action->Swarming.description:
A ratfolk can end its movement in the same square as an ally that also has this ability.

Only two such criaturas can share the same space.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conjuro-effects.Item.qkwb5DD3zmKwvbk0]

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aAbfKn8maGjJjk2W]{Mystic Armor}

Tú ward yourself with shimmering magical energy, gaining a +1 bonificador por objeto to AC and a maximum Dexterity modifier of +5. While wearing mage armor, tú use tu unarmored proficiency to calculate tu AC.

action->Eschew Materials.name: Eschew Materials
action->Eschew Materials.description:
Puedes use clever workarounds to replicate the arcane essence of certain materials. When tú @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Lanzar un conjuro} that requires material components, puedes provide these material components without a conjuro component pouch by drawing intricate replacement sigils in the air.

Unlike when providing somatic components, tú still must have a hand completely free. Este doesn't remove the need for any materials listed in the conjuro's cost entry.

Kharnas's Lesser Glyph.name: Kharnas's Lesser Glyph
Kharnas's Lesser Glyph.description: A hidden glyph suddenly lights up and dominates the mind of any criatura not bearing the sigil of Kharnas the Angel-Binder.
Kharnas's Lesser Glyph.disable: Disable @Check[thievery|dc:46|name:Destroy Glyph|traits:action:disable-a-device] (legendario) to destroy the glyph, @Check[arcana|dc:42|name:Divert Glyph's Power] (maestro) to harmlessly divert the glyph's power, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank; counteract DC 38) to counteract the glyph
Kharnas's Lesser Glyph.reset: The glyph can affect two criaturas before it deactivates for 5 minutes and automatically resets.

action->Dominate.name: Dominar
action->Dominate.description:
Desencadenante A criatura who doesn't bear the sigil of Kharnas attempts to open the door

Efecto A surge of the Radiant Spark's latent power courses through the glyph and washes over the triggering criatura. If the criatura is undead, it takes @Damage[10d10[vitality]] daño. If it's living, it instead regains @Damage[10d10[healing]] Puntos de Golpe. It then must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:40|traits:incapacitation,mental] salvación or be affected by a 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} conjuro.

The conjuro commands the affected criatura to attack the nearest criatura who doesn't bear the sigil of Kharnas.

equipment->Standard Skeleton Key.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.fprUZviW8khm2BLo]
Standard Skeleton Key
equipment->Standard Skeleton Key.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.fprUZviW8khm2BLo]

A grinning skull tops the bow of this macabre key. Este key can be used in place of thieves' tools when attempting to PICK A LOCK, and it grants a +1 bonificador por objeto to the THIEVERY check.

If the skeleton key becomes broken due to a critical failure on the check, it works as normal thieves' tools and loses its benefits until repaired.

Activar F INTERACT

Frecuencia una vez al día

Desencadenante Intentas to PICK A LOCK but haven't rolled yet

Efecto The key casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6Ot4N22t5tPD51BO]{Knock} on the lock estás trying to pick.

action->Scurry.name: Scurry
action->Scurry.description:
Desencadenante A criatura ends its movement adjacent to Kolo

Efecto Kolo Steps.

action->Upward Stab.name: Upward Stab
action->Upward Stab.description: Kolo's melee Golpes deal an extra 1d6 daño de precisión to Medium or larger criaturas.

Lie-Master.name: Lie-Master
Lie-Master.publicNotes:
Glabrezus are looming behemoths who revel in the act of twisting mortal desires into their ultimate ruin, betraying and manipulating as easily as they breathe. Desires granted by a glabrezu always come to fruition in the most destructive way possible, turning a wish or hope into a potent and devastating act of betrayal-although the long-term repercussions are not always immediately apparent. For example, a struggling arma smith might wish for fame and skill at their craft, only to find that their best patron is a cruel and sadistic murderer who uses the armas in bloody sprees. Or a lonely widower might have his desire granted in the form of a lost love returned to "life" as a vampire. Glabrezus are nothing if not creative in addressing a mortal's needs.

Estos massive demons have enormous pincers and a pair of smaller humanoid arms sprouting from their chests, but their size belies their skill at magic, and they possess formidable innate conjuros. Treachery demons arise from the souls of mortals engaged in treason and DECEPTION.
Lie-Master.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tsKnoBuBbKMXkiz5]

consumable->Black Dragon's Breath Potion.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.LR7Ke2V8vHjQYBni]

Este liquid contains blood from a black dragon. For 1 hora after tú imbibe the concoction, puedes unleash a black dragon's breath arma. The potency of the breath depends on the potion's type, based on the age of the dragon whose blood was used to make the potion.

Exhaling dragon breath uses a single action. Creas a @Template[line|distance:30] of acid which deals @Damage[10d6[acid]|options:area-damage] daño. All criaturas in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:37|basic|options:area-effect] salvación.

After tú use the breath arma, puedes't do so again for [[/r 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Truth Vulnerability.name: Truth Vulnerability
action->Truth Vulnerability.description: A glabrezu's lies sustain them, and the truth can destroy them. Siempre que a revelation effect counteracts or reveals the glabrezu's illusions or the glabrezu fails a save against an effect that would prevent them from lying (such as zone of truth), the demon takes @Damage[(3d6+4)[mental]] daño. They take this daño only once per effect, even if the effect reveals multiple illusions or prevents multiple lies.

action->Captive Rake.name: Captive Rake
action->Captive Rake.description:
Requisitos A criatura is grabbed in the glabrezu's pincer.

Efecto The glabrezu pulls the grabbed criatura up to 5 pies closer, then makes two claw Golpes against it. Those Golpes count as one attack when determining a treachery demon's multiple attack penalización, and the penalización doesn't increase until after both Golpes.

action->Steady Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros firme
action->Steady Spellcasting.description: When a reaction would disrupt a glabrezu's conjuro, the demon can attempt a @Check[flat|dc:17] check, avoiding the disruption on a success.

action->Sudden Betrayal.name: Sudden Betrayal
action->Sudden Betrayal.description: A glabrezu can always use DECEPTION when rolling initiative as long as they're aware of at least one opponent before initiative is rolled. When using DECEPTION for initiative, the demon gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to DECEPTION.

action->Tentacle Trip.name: Tentacle Trip
action->Tentacle Trip.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within 15 pies of the lie-maestro uses a manipulate or move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using

Efecto The criatura must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:34] salvación or be knocked prone by the lie-maestro's clockwork tentacles.

action->Treacherous Veil.name: Treacherous Veil
action->Treacherous Veil.description: A glabrezu's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Illusory Disguise} can allow it to appear as a criatura of any size.

action->Twisted Desires.name: Twisted Desires
action->Twisted Desires.description: Once per month, a glabrezu can grant a mortal humanoid the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YfJTXyVGzLhM6V8U]{Miracle} conjuro granted by an Abyssal patron, though the glabrezu always perverts the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YfJTXyVGzLhM6V8U]{Miracle} according to their own treacherous NATURE.

action->Grab.name: Agarrón
action->Grab.description:
Requisitos The monster's last action was a success with a Golpe that lists GRAB in its daño entry, or it has a criatura grabbed using this action.

Efecto The monster automatically Grabs el objetivo until the end of the monster's next turn. The criatura is grabbed by whichever body part the monster attacked with, and that body part can't be used to Golpe criaturas until the GRAB is ended. Using GRAB extends the duration of the monster's GRAB until the end of its next turn for all criaturas grabbed by it. A grabbed criatura can use the Escape action to get out of the GRAB, and the GRAB ends for a grabbed criaturas if the monster moves away from it.

Life Magnet.name: Life Magnet
Life Magnet.description: A magical magnet hidden behind a panel in the corner of the room pulls not metal but living criaturas toward it, heedless of any obstacles in the way.
Life Magnet.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:29|name:Deactivate Panel|traits:action:disable-a-device] (experto) to deactivate the panel, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (4th rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the panel's magic
Life Magnet.reset: La trampa deactivates and resets 1 minuto after there are no criaturas touching the iron bars.
Life Magnet.routine:
(1 action) La trampa pulls up to four criaturas that have already triggered its Magnetize the Living ability toward one of the far corners of the room, possibly pressing them into the iron bars. If all the iron bars between an affected criatura and the magnetic panel remain intact, the criatura takes @Damage[(2d10+10)[bludgeoning]] daño with a @Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic|options:inflicts:restrained] salvación and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} on a failure ([[/act escape dc=23]]).

If an iron bar has been broken, the criatura takes @Damage[(1d10+5)[bludgeoning]] daño instead, and if two consecutive bars have been broken the criatura takes no daño (but might still be restrained on a failed save).

action->Magnetize the Living.name: Magnetize the Living
action->Magnetize the Living.description:
Desencadenante A criatura touches any of the iron bars in this area or touches a criatura already affected by the trap

Efecto The magical panel hidden in the far corner of the chamber (either the western or the eastern corner, depending on which side of the room the criatura was closest to when it triggered the trap) "magnetizes" the triggering criatura and violently pulls it toward the corner, automatically dealing @Damage[(2d10+10)[bludgeoning]] daño to the criatura.

La trampa then rolls initiative if it hasn't already done so.

action->Backdrop.name: Backdrop
action->Backdrop.description: When a criatura attempts to Golpe a living mural and critically misses, the attacker hits the surface (a wall, canvas, or so on) behind the living mural. Este can daño or break the arma or surface.

action->Surface-Bound.name: Surface-Bound
action->Surface-Bound.description:
A living mural can move only along flat surfaces such as floors and walls. Este allows it to end its movement wrapped around corners when on a continuous surface.

If the surface it's on is destroyed (such as a portrait hit by a fireball conjuro or a puddle being splashed), the mural takes @Damage[10d6[untyped]] daño and is shunted to the nearest flat surface. If there is no flat surface within 5 pies, the living mural is destroyed.

action->Collective Attack.name: Collective Attack
action->Collective Attack.description:
The subjects depicted within the living mural all reach out at once to attack. The living mural makes a fist Golpe against each target within range.

Estos attacks count toward the living mural's multiple attack penalización, but this penalización doesn't increase until after all of the attacks are made.

action->Paint the Masses.name: Paint the Masses
action->Paint the Masses.description:
The living mural expels a @Template[cone|distance:15] of paint.

Las criaturas in the area must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:41] salvación or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} for 1 asalto.

The living mural can't use Paint the Masses again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Paint the Masses]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Splash of Color.name: Splash of Color
action->Splash of Color.description: When the living mural hits with a splatter attack, el objetivo is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} for 1 asalto.

Living Paints.name: Living Paints
Living Paints.description: A mass of brushes use magical paint to convert criaturas into art.
Living Paints.disable: @Check[crafting|dc:41|name:Crafting Disable] (maestro) to mix the paints into bland, useless colors, @Check[thievery|dc:41|name:Thievery Disable] (legendario) to dismantle the animated brushes, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (8th rank; counteract DC 41) to counteract the magic within the paint.

action->Capture Subject.name: Capture Subject
action->Capture Subject.description:
Desencadenante A criatura steps into the same space as the paints

Efecto The brushes animate and attempt to paint all criaturas within 30 pies. The criaturas must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:41] salvación to avoid the brushes and splashes from paint cans or be converted into living artwork for 1 hora.

A criatura that becomes living artwork is immediately bound to the nearest flat surface of its size or larger within 30 pies. The criatura can move only along flat surfaces such as floors and walls. Este allows it to end its movement wrapped around corners when on a continuous surface.

While bound to a surface, the criatura can attack from its space as normal, including against other criaturas bound to the same surface.

If the surface it's on is destroyed (such as a portrait hit by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball} conjuro or a wall being demolished), the criatura takes @Damage[10d6[untyped]] daño and is shunted to the nearest flat surface. If there is no flat surface within 5 pies, the criatura is destroyed.

weapon->+3 Greater Striking speed Handwr.name: +3 Greater Striking speed Handwraps of Mighty Blows

action->Attack of Opportunity.name: Ataque de oportunidad
action->Attack of Opportunity.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Efecto The monster attempts a melee Golpe against the triggering criatura. If the attack is a impacto crítico and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. Este Golpe doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalización, and its multiple attack penalización doesn't apply to this Golpe.

action->Double Punch.name: Double Punch
action->Double Punch.description: Lord Guirden makes two fist Golpes, ignoring the multiple attack penalización until after both Golpes.

action->Hurl.name: Hurl
action->Hurl.description:
Requisitos Lord Guirden has a Medium or smaller criatura grabbed

Efecto Lord Guirden hurls the grabbed criatura into a target adjacent to him. He makes a fist Golpe against the adjacent target. On a success, el objetivo and hurled criatura both take 3d10+14 daño contundente and are knocked prone. On a failure, only the thrown criatura takes the daño and is knocked prone.

action->Master Brawler.name: Master Brawler
action->Master Brawler.description: Siempre que Lord Guirden makes a fist Golpe and hits, he can elige to apply either the GRAB, Knockdown, or Push ability to his attack.

Lusca.name: Lusca
Lusca.publicNotes: A lusca is a predatory sea monster that resembles a three-headed shark with the body of an octopus. Ferocious electrical storms usually herald a lusca's arrival; such violent bursts of electricity result from the criatura's superconductive flesh, which allows the lusca to store energy from lightning strikes that it can then discharge at foes.

action->Attack of Opportunity.name: Ataque de oportunidad
action->Attack of Opportunity.description:
The lusca gains 2 extra reactions at the start of each of its turns that it can use only to make an Attack of Opportunity with its jaws. It can't use more than one Attack of Opportunity triggered by the same action.

Desencadenante A criatura within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Efecto The monster attempts a melee Golpe against the triggering criatura. If the attack is a impacto crítico and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. Este Golpe doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalización, and its multiple attack penalización doesn't apply to this Golpe.

action->Blood Scent.name: Blood Scent
action->Blood Scent.description: El lusca puede smell sangre en el agua up a 1 mile away.

action->Storm Bringer.name: Storm Bringer
action->Storm Bringer.description: Cuando el lusca es near el surface for more than 1 hora, clouds appear y deliver un thunderstorm con un 2-mile radius centered en su location. El weather returns a normal 1 hora after el lusca departs.

action->Capsize.name: Capsize
action->Capsize.description: The lusca tries to capsize an adjacent aquatic vessel of its size or smaller. It must succeed at an ATHLETICS check with a DC of 35 (reduced by 5 for each size smaller the vessel is than the lusca) or the pilot's Sailing LORE DC, whichever is higher.

action->Lusca Venom.name: Lusca Venom
action->Lusca Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:38]

Duración máxima 6 asaltos

Etapa 1 4d6 daño de veneno and torpe 1 (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 6d6 daño de veneno and torpe 2 (1 asalto)

action->Ravenous Jaws.name: Ravenous Jaws
action->Ravenous Jaws.description: The lusca makes three jaws Golpes, each against a different target. Estos attacks count toward the lusca's multiple attack penalización, but the penalización doesn't increase until after the lusca makes all of these attacks. If the lusca subsequently uses the GRAB action, it Grabs any number of criaturas it hit with Ravenous Jaws.

El objetivo must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] salvación. On a failure, the criatura takes daño as if hit by Maurrisa's fist Golpe, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1}. On a critical failure, the criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 3} instead.

action->Fast Swallow.description:
Desencadenante The minchgorm Grabs a criatura in its jaws

Efecto The minchgorm uses Swallow Whole.

action->Riptide.name: Aguas revueltas
action->Riptide.description: Tentacles of water rise up and attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} all enemies within 15 pies of the minchgorm. The minchgorm attempts an @Check[athletics] check against the Fortitude DC of each criatura in the area. On a success, the criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} (Escape DC 40). On a critical success, or a success against a criatura that is already grabbed, el objetivo begins to drown.

action->Watery Simulacra.name: Watery Simulacra
action->Watery Simulacra.description: The minchgorm raises up to eight figures from nearby water, each appearing in an empty space within 60 pies of the minchgorm. A simulacrum can take any shape of size Medium or smaller that the minchgorm desires, including that of a specific individual or object, but is always plainly made of water. The minchgorm can speak, cast conjuros, and use its senses through its simulacra, spending actions for a simulacrum on a one-for-one basis. By using a single action with the concentrate rasgo, the minchgorm can cause any number of simulacra to Fly, Dar un paso, Zancada, or Swim up to 60 pies. A simulacrum uses the minchgorm's AC and tiradas de salvación and has 30 Puntos de Golpe. A minchgorm can have up to eight simulacra in existence at once. Simulacra dissolve immediately when more than 60 pies from the minchgorm, or if the minchgorm dies or falls unconscious. The minchgorm can dismiss any number of its simulacra as a free action.

Miogimo.saveDetails: +1 bonificador de estado to Will saves vs. mental effects

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]

spell->Veil.name: Veil
spell->Veil.description:
Tú disguise the targets as other criaturas of the same body shape and roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise can hide the targets' identities or let them appear to be of another ancestry, but it's not precise enough to impersonate specific individuals. The conjuro doesn't change voice, scent, or mannerisms. Tú elige the disguise for each target; for example, tú could make one target appear to be a dwarf and another an elf. Casting veil counts as setting up a disguise for the purpose of the Impersonate action. It allows el objetivo to ignore any circumstance penalties they might take for being disguised as dissimilar criaturas, and it gives the targets a +4 bonificador de estado to DECEPTION checks to prevent others from seeing through their disguises, and add their level even if untrained. Puedes Dismiss any or all of these disguises.

Heightened (5th) The conjuro also disguises the targets' voices and scents; it gains the auditory and olfactory rasgos.

Heightened (7th) The targets can appear as any criatura of the same size, even specific individuals. Debes have seen an individual to reproduce their appearance. The conjuro also disguises the targets' voices and scents; it gains the auditory and olfactory rasgos.

action->Little Favors.description: Each time a criatura willingly performs a service, quest, or task for the zealborn, the criatura takes a cumulative -1 penalización de estado to tiradas de salvación against the zealborn's mental conjuros and abilities (maximum -4).

action->Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenecimiento
action->Rejuvenation.description: When Miogimo is destroyed, he re-forms, fully healed, near a follower of his choice in [[/gmr 1d10 #Rejuvenation]]{1d10 days}. For the purposes of rejuvenation, a follower is defined as an intelligent criatura who's well acquainted with Miogimo and is a true believer in Miogimo's mission, not merely a lukewarm supporter. Miogimo can be permanently destroyed only if he has no current followers or can be convinced to end his own life.

action->Trickster's Ace.name: As Del Embaucamiento
action->Trickster's Ace.description:
Desencadenante An effect would cause Miogimo to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado} or would slow his movement

Efecto Miogimo casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]{Unfettered Movement} on himself.

action->Zealous Restoration.name: Zealous Restoration
action->Zealous Restoration.description: Miogimo can't regain Puntos de Golpe through resting or curación de vacío; he feeds only on the idealism of his supporters, regaining 10 Puntos de Golpe per day for each criatura under the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Q690d3mw3TUrKX7E]{Geas} cast by Miogimo. Las criaturas under Miogimo's geas have their maximum HP reduced by 10 each day until they are burned away to a husk and perish. After 24 horas, such criaturas rise as zeal-damned ghouls under Miogimo's control. Zeal-damned ghouls eat only the flesh of evil or chaotic criaturas and deal an additional 1d6 spirit and 1d6 daño de vacío with their attacks.

She also gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia against sonic effects and effects that impose the deafened condition

action->Swift Sneak.description: Mobana puede mover su full speed cuando @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneaking}.

action->Deny Advantage.description: Mobana isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to criaturas of 8th level or lower that are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{No detectado}, flanking or using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.w6rMqmGzhUahdnA7]{Surprise Attack}.

action->Ooze Tendril.name: Ooze Tendril
action->Ooze Tendril.description: Mother Venom can command her minions and the oozes that cover her dungeon to attack foes. As long as she's conscious, she can make melee ooze tendril Golpes that originate from any slime-covered terrain in her dungeon, including the dungeon's walls and doors, or from a space occupied by one of her children of venom.

action->Spit.name: Spit
action->Spit.description: A criatura hit by Mother Venom's spit attack is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} and stuck to the nearest surface (Escape DC 38).

Mr. Snips.name: Mr. Snips
Mr. Snips.publicNotes: Traditionally crafted into the forms of giant suits of armor or powerful animals, iron golems are products of exquisite artistry and skill. Their articulated joints and sturdy armored bodies require great care and mathematical precision to craft, and regular cleaning and oiling ensure they don't rust over the ages. With proper care, iron golems can remain in good shape for thousands of years, being passed down for generations, as long as they aren't destroyed by meddlesome adventurers. In addition to their incredible strength, iron golems possess a potent toxic breath arma that is often more than enough to dispatch entire groups of opponents.

action->Golem Antimagic.name: Golem Antimagic
action->Golem Antimagic.description:
Harmed by acid (@Damage[(6d10+4)[untyped]], @Damage[(2d8+4)[untyped]] from areas and daño persistente); healed by fire (area @Damage[(2d8+4)[healing]] HP); ralentizado by electricity

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.GolemAntimagic]

action->Vulnerable to Neutralize Poison.name: Vulnerable to Neutralize Poison
action->Vulnerable to Neutralize Poison.description: Casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} en el golem deactivates su Breath arma durante 1 minuto.

action->Vulnerable to Rust.name: Vulnerable to Rust
action->Vulnerable to Rust.description: Los efectos magicos de oxidacion, como las antenas de un monstruo de oxido, afectan al golem de hierro con normalidad.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
The iron golem exhales poisonous gas in a @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-pies radius} centered on the corner of one of the iron golem's squares.

The gas persists for 1 asalto. Any criatura in the area (or that later enters the area) is exposed to the iron golem's poison.

The golem can't use its Arma de aliento again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Dismember.name: Dismember
action->Dismember.description:
Siempre que Mr. Snips rolls a impacto crítico with a scissors Golpe, in addition to dealing daño adicional, the golem has a chance to dismember its victim. El objetivo must roll a @Check[reflex|dc:39|traits:damaging-effect] salvación.

Éxito No additional effect.

Fallo El objetivo takes @Damage[2d10[bleed]].

Fallo crítico As failure, and one of the targets extremities is severed (the effects of this are up to the GM's discretion).

action->Inexorable March.name: Inexorable March
action->Inexorable March.description: The iron golem Strides up to its Velocidad, pushing back each criatura whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A criatura can attempt to bar the way by succeeding at a @Check[fortitude|dc:39] salvación. On a critical success, the resisting criatura takes no daño; otherwise, it is damaged as if hit by the golem's fist.

action->Iron Golem Poison.name: Iron Golem Poison
action->Iron Golem Poison.description:
Any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado} value from this poison is reduced by 1 every hour.

Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:35]

Duración máxima 4 asaltos

Etapa 1 2d6 poison and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 4d6 poison and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 2} (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 8d6 poison and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 3} (1 asalto).

Este gemstone grants its wearer a +2 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de salvación.

Each heartstone is powered by the spirit of a specific night hag. If it's separated from her for 24 horas (or she's been dead for 24 horas), it becomes a nonmagical gemstone. A heartstone allows the hag to use additional occult innate conjuros: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D2nPKbIS67m9199U]{Ethereal Jaunt} (9th level) and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul} at will, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IqJ9URobmJ9L9UBG]{Shadow Blast} twice per day.

Requisitos Debes be touching the heartstone.

Efecto The heartstone attempts to counteract one disease affecting tú (counteract rank 5, counteract modifier +18).

Requisitos de fabricación Debes be a night hag.

action->Nightmare Rider.description: When a night hag rides a nightmare, the nightmare also gains the night hag's bonificador de estado to saves against magic, and both the hag and rider benefit when the night hag uses her heartstone's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D2nPKbIS67m9199U]{Ethereal Jaunt} innate conjuro.

action->Planar Coven.description: As long as at least one other member of Myrna's coven is on the demiplane of Stormholt, the coven members add chain lightning, lightning bolt, plane shift, and punishing winds to their conjuros, each of which can be cast at up to 8th level.

action->Illusory Persona.name: Illusory Persona
action->Illusory Persona.description: The illusion created by the myrucarx's project image can resemble any Medium humanoid, including any specific individual it has seen, and has appropriate voice, scent, and mannerisms, allowing the myrucarx to use its DECEPTION check to Impersonate that humanoid if it chooses.

action->Twisting Reach.name: Twisting Reach
action->Twisting Reach.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Efecto The fanged mouths at the ends of a myrucarx's tendrils twist around obstacles. The myrucarx makes two jaws Golpes against the same target, ignoring el objetivo's cover. Both attacks count toward the myrucarx's multiple attack penalización, but the penalización doesn't increase until after both attacks are made. The myrucarx can't GRAB as its next action after Twisting Reach.

action->Najra Lizard Venom.description:
The criatura is extremely thirsty and can't quench its thirst while poisoned

Etapa 2 as stage 1 (1 hora)

action->Najra Swarm Attack.name: Najra Swarm Attack
action->Najra Swarm Attack.description: The najra lizard's melee Golpes deal 1d6 daño de precisión to criaturas sharing a square with more than one najra lizard.

Needling Stairs.name: Needling Stairs
Needling Stairs.description: Este staircase has springs in each step, which send poisoned needles shooting up through tiny holes in the wood when stepped on. Each step, 6 in total, takes up one 5-pies square.
Needling Stairs.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:33|name:Disable Stair Spring|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) on each stair to disable its spring, or deactivate the switch in area C8 to deactivate the whole trap. Cutting the wire on the topmost stair ([[/act disable-device dc=35]]) that connects the staircase to the control switch prevents the control switch from turning the trap on or off.
Needling Stairs.hpDetails: a romper el spring under el dar un paso y make que dar un paso safe a stand en
Needling Stairs.reset: Si deactivated via el switch, el trampa puede be reactivated con el switch en area C8.
Needling Stairs.routine: (1 action) La trampa makes a separate poisoned needle Golpe against each criatura currently on an active step as 1 action. Because it is constantly jabbing needles up through any weight-bearing steps, the trap can also use its Bloody Feet free action to jab at a criatura on one of the steps during that criatura's turn.

action->First Step.name: First Dar un paso
action->First Step.description:

action->Easy to Call.name: Easy to Call
action->Easy to Call.description: El sahkil es considered 2 levels lower for el purposes de being summoned by rituals (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2ykmAVKrsAWcazcC]{Binding Circle}), but es always free a ataque o leave instead de negotiate unless el primary caster's prueba es un critical success.

action->Skip Between.name: Skip Between
action->Skip Between.description: El sahkil puede mover itself between el Ethereal Plane y el Material Plane, as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D2nPKbIS67m9199U]{Ethereal Jaunt}, except que este ability tiene un unlimited duration y puede be Dismissed.

action->Tainted Backlash.name: Tainted Backlash
action->Tainted Backlash.description:
A criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado} by the sahkil's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.O6VQC1Bs4aSYDa6R]{Mask of Terror} is gripped with fear of the ways magic can go wrong.

The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 2} for as long as it is asustado. If the criatura Casts a Spell during its turn, it can't reduce its asustado condition at the end of that turn.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.6nrCxNQFycUVFOV2]

Necesitas thieves' tools to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the THIEVERY skill. Infiltrator thieves' tools add a +1 bonificador por objeto to checks to Pick Locks and Disable Devices.

If tu thieves' tools are broken, puedes REPAIR them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.BznmPaRjI4Orb0IH]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to tu tools; this doesn't require using the REPAIR action. If tú wear tu thieves' tools, puedes draw and replace them as part of the action that uses them.

Este long, hollow proboscis is harvested from the notorious bloodseeker beast and drips a trickle of blood.

Activar F imaginar

Desencadenante Impactas an desprevenido criatura with the affixed arma

When tú activate the beak, tú deal an extra 1d4 daño de precisión on tu tirada de daño. If tú deal sneak attack daño to the criatura, tú also deal @Damage[1d4[bleed]].

action->Deny Advantage.name: Negar ventaja
action->Deny Advantage.description: The poisoner isn't desprevenido to criaturas of 11th level or lower that are hidden, undetected, flanking, or using surprise attack.

action->Nimble Dodge.name: Esquiva ágil
action->Nimble Dodge.description:
Desencadenante The poisoner is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker it can see

Efecto The poisoner gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC against el ataque desencadenante.

action->Impromptu Toxin.name: Impromptu Toxin
action->Impromptu Toxin.description:
Cost 1 batch of infused reagents

Efecto The poisoner dribbles a few experimental chemicals over a melee arma. Until the start of their next turn, Golpes with the arma deal an additional @Damage[2d8[poison]] daño, and targets hit by Golpes with the arma must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:27|traits:damaging-effect] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1} (the poisoner's choice) for [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Unbalancing Blow.name: Golpe desequilibrante
action->Unbalancing Blow.description: Las criaturas the poisoner hits with a impacto crítico are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} against their attacks until the end of their next turn.

action->Change Shape.name: Cambiar de forma
action->Change Shape.description: The obrousian can take on the appearance of any Small or Medium humanoid. Este increases their Velocidad to 25 pies. It doesn't change their attack and daño modifiers with their Golpes, but it might change the tipo de daño their Golpes deal (typically to bludgeoning).

action->Drowning Grasp.name: Drowning Grasp
action->Drowning Grasp.description: When a criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the obrousian, its lungs magically fill with water. A criatura that can't breathe water is suffocating while it is grabbed.

Tienes fewer actions. Slowed always includes a value. When tú regain tu actions at the start of tu turn, reduce the number of actions tú regain by tu ralentizado value. Because ralentizado has its effect at the start of tu turn, tú don't immediately lose actions if tú become ralentizado during tu turn.

action->Corpse Wallow.name: Corpse Wallow
action->Corpse Wallow.description: The ofalth zombie gains curacion rapida 2 as long as it is in the Catacombs or another area with a high concentration of dead.

action->Rotting Aura.name: Rotting Aura
action->Rotting Aura.description:
10 pies. The zombie emits an aura of rot and disease that causes wounds to fester and turn sour. Any living criatura that starts its turn within 10 pies of the Ofalth Zombie and is not at full Puntos de Golpe takes @Damage[2d6[untyped]] daño as its wounds fester.

Las criaturas that take a impacto crítico from the Ofalth Zombie also take this daño immediately.

Note: Este ability lists a DC 24 in the source, but the glossary ability lacks a save to make.

action->Slow.name: Lentificar
action->Slow.description: The ofalth zombie is permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} and can't use reactions.

action->Bury in Offal.name: Bury in Offal
action->Bury in Offal.description:
The ofalth zombie makes a fling offal Golpe and compares the tirada de ataque result to the AC of any foes within the area of a @Template[cone|distance:15] emanating from the ofalth zombie. Este counts as two attacks for the ofalth zombie's multiple attack penalización.

The ofalth zombie can't use Bury in Offal again until it moves at least 10 pies to a different space.

Pelmo.name: Pelmo
Pelmo.publicNotes:
The frontline fighters of goblin tribes prefer to fight in large groups-especially when they can outnumber their foes at least three to one.

Estos small humanoids have green or gray skin and large heads with wide ears. While some goblins are civilized and have worked hard to be considered upstanding members of humanoid communities, most are impetuous and vicious criaturas who delight in wreaking havoc. Estos goblins think nothing of slaughtering livestock, stealing infants, or burning down a building purely for momentary delight. They revel in playing malicious tricks on taller humanoids, whom they call "longshanks."

Goblins are superstitious, with an intense awe of magic and a fascination with fire; goblins who maestro magic or fire earn great respect from their kin. Most other humanoids find it difficult to understand goblins' outlook: they hate canines but eagerly share their lairs with so-called "goblin dogs," they fearlessly attack larger criaturas but are terrified of horses, and they despise vegetables yet consider pickles a delicacy. To a goblin, of course, these are all perfectly sensible life choices.

action->Construct Armor (Hardness 10).name: Armadura de constructo (Dureza 10)
action->Construct Armor (Hardness 10).description: Like normal objects, a giant animated statue has Hardness. Este Hardness reduces any daño it takes by an amount equal to the Hardness. Once a giant animated statue is reduced to less than half its Puntos de Golpe, or immediately upon being damaged by a impacto crítico, its armadura de constructo breaks and its ARMOR CLASS is reduced to 22.

action->Stone Robes.name: Stone Robes
action->Stone Robes.description:
The Prospecti statue turns suddenly, causing its robes, which flow like fabric despite being as hard as stone, to swing about and daño opponents.

Las criaturas adjacent to the animated statue take @Damage[(2d6+6)[bludgeoning]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] salvación; on a critical failure, the criatura is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}).

Pulping Golem.name: Pulping Golem
Pulping Golem.publicNotes: Traditionally crafted into the forms of giant suits of armor or powerful animals, iron golems are products of exquisite artistry and skill. Their articulated joints and sturdy armored bodies require great care and mathematical precision to craft, and regular cleaning and oiling ensure they don't rust over the ages. With proper care, iron golems can remain in good shape for thousands of years, being passed down for generations, as long as they aren't destroyed by meddlesome adventurers. In addition to their incredible strength, iron golems possess a potent toxic breath arma that is often more than enough to dispatch entire groups of opponents.

action->Golem Antimagic.name: Golem Antimagic
action->Golem Antimagic.description:
Harmed by acid (@Damage[(6d10+4)[untyped]], @Damage[(2d8+4)[untyped]] from areas and daño persistente); healed by fire (area @Damage[(2d8+4)[healing]] HP); ralentizado by electricity

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.GolemAntimagic]

action->Vulnerable to Neutralize Poison.name: Vulnerable to Neutralize Poison
action->Vulnerable to Neutralize Poison.description: Casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} en el golem deactivates su Breath arma durante 1 minuto.

action->Vulnerable to Rust.name: Vulnerable to Rust
action->Vulnerable to Rust.description: Los efectos magicos de oxidacion, como las antenas de un monstruo de oxido, afectan al golem de hierro con normalidad.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
The pulping golem spills its cauldron stomach to the floor, dealing @Damage[9d12[fire]|options:area-damage] daño to criaturas within 10 pies (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] salvación).

It can't use Arma de aliento again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Extend Legs.name: Extend Legs
action->Extend Legs.description: The pulping golem extends its legs up to a height of 40 pies, raising its body high into the air. While its legs are extended, its movement speed is halved, and it takes a -2 penalización to its Fortitude save DC against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} attempts.

action->Inexorable March.name: Inexorable March
action->Inexorable March.description: The iron golem Strides up to its Velocidad, pushing back each criatura whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A criatura can attempt to bar the way by succeeding at a @Check[fortitude|dc:39] salvación. On a critical success, the resisting criatura takes no daño; otherwise, it is damaged as if hit by the golem's fist.

action->Iron Golem Poison.name: Iron Golem Poison
action->Iron Golem Poison.description:
Any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado} value from this poison is reduced by 1 every hour.

Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:35]

Duración máxima 4 asaltos

Etapa 1 2d6+4 poison and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 4d6+4 poison and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 2} (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 8d6+4 poison and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 3} (1 asalto).

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FABVnBeYtGXshlwm]

Este ring magically conceals any armor and sheathed armas estás wearing by either turning them invisible or creating the illusion of ordinary clothes. The ring doesn't change tu appearance beyond concealing armas and armor. As soon as tú wield a arma, the arma becomes obvious to onlookers and is no longer affected by the ring until tú sheathe the arma for at least 1 minuto. A criatura can disbelieve this illusion by Seeking or any time it hits tú with an attack.

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When tú drink a healing potion, tú regain @Damage[(2d8+5)[healing]] Puntos de Golpe.

Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Estos attacks count toward Ralso's multiple attack penalización, but the penalización doesn't increase until after both attacks.

Este counts as two attacks for the ravenile's multiple attack penalización.

If this Golpe hits, the ravenile deals an extra die of daño del arma and el objetivo falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

action->Clockwork Reconstruction.name: Clockwork Reconstruction
action->Clockwork Reconstruction.description: Each time Reginald is reborn in his lair, his machines graft him with a new clockwork modification. He chooses one of his abilities with the clockwork rasgo. He gains access to this ability but can't use any of his other clockwork abilities. He can't elige the same ability twice in a row. He begins with Ink Blood active.

action->Ink Blood.name: Ink Blood
action->Ink Blood.description:
Reginald's body is filled with toxic ink

Desencadenante An adjacent criatura Golpes Reginald with a melee arma or ataque sin armas and deals daño

Efecto The criatura is exposed to Reginald's poison ink.

action->Secret of Rebirth.name: Secret of Rebirth
action->Secret of Rebirth.description: If a criatura with less than 5 Secret Knowledge points reduces Reginald to 0 HP (or dealt the last daño to him before he dies from using Overdrive Engine), Reginald's body dissipates into a puddle of ink and releases a black wave of psychic energy. Each criatura within 30 pies is bathed in a torrent of forbidden secrets and gains 1 Secret Knowledge point. Reginald's body reforms [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} later in his sanctum at full health at a location of his choosing (typically the Pool of Secrets, area L11). Este ability activates automatically with no action necessary on Vancaskerkin's behalf.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description: Reginald's lungs are equipped with ink canisters, allowing him to spew a @Template[line|distance:60] of ink that deals @Damage[9d6[poison]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:39|basic|options:area-effect] salvación; on a failure, the criatura is also subjected to Reginald's poison ink).

action->Overdrive Engine.name: Overdrive Engine
action->Overdrive Engine.description:
Reginald is equipped with clockwork organs to power his body

Requisitos Reginald has 175 Puntos de Golpe or fewer

Efecto Reginald gains 200 Puntos de Golpe temporales, a +15-pies bonificador de estado to Velocidad, and a +2 bonificador de estado to melee tiradas de ataque. His body begins to overheat, spewing steam that deals @Damage[9d6[fire]|options:area-damage] daño at the beginning of his turn to all criaturas within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 pies} (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|options:area-effect] salvación). After 2 asaltos, Reginald explodes, dealing @Damage[19d6[fire]] daño to all criaturas within @Template[emanation|distance:60]{60 pies} (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic] salvación). Reginald dies. For the purposes of his Secret of Rebirth ability, the last criatura to daño Reginald counts as killing him.

action->Poison Ink.name: Poison Ink
action->Poison Ink.description:
Reginald is immune to the toxic ink that flows through his veins

Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:38]

Duración máxima 10 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[4d6[poison]] @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2} (1 asalto).

action->Quill Cannon.name: Quill Cannon
action->Quill Cannon.description: Reginald is equipped with a cannon and hundreds of steel quills. He makes two steel quill attacks against every criatura in a @Template[cone|distance:60], ignoring the multiple attack penalización until after all attacks are made. He can't use Quill Cannon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Quill Cannon]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Reflective Plating.name: Reflective Plating
action->Reflective Plating.description: Reginald engages su defensive plating, que casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OOELvfkTedBMlWtq]{Spell Turning} en him (counteract modifier +32).

action->Slither.name: Culebrear
action->Slither.description: With his body composed of ink and gears, Reginald can move through tight spaces as if he were a Tiny criatura, treating them as difficult terrain.

action->Plunder Life.name: Plunder Life
action->Plunder Life.description:
60 pies. When a healing effect restores Puntos de Golpe to a non-fiend criatura in the aura, the amount of Puntos de Golpe restored is halved. The rhevanna gains Puntos de Golpe temporales equal to the amount of Puntos de Golpe restored.

The rhevanna loses any remaining Puntos de Golpe temporales after 1 minuto.

action->Detaining Strike.name: Detaining Golpe
action->Detaining Strike.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Desencadenante The rhevanna hits a criatura with a arma Golpe

Efecto The rhevanna casts an innate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ksLCg62cLOojw3gN]{Planar Tether} conjuro on the criatura.

action->Lifedrinker.name: Lifedrinker
action->Lifedrinker.description:
Desencadenante The rhevanna kills a living criatura of at least 16th level

Efecto The rhevanna drinks the triggering criatura's life force and regains @Damage[40[healing]] Puntos de Golpe. If the triggering criatura is a celestial, the rhevanna instead regains @Damage[80[healing]] Puntos de Golpe.

action->Malefic Binding.name: Malefic Binding
action->Malefic Binding.description:
El rhevanna puede objetivo celestials con su @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul} ability, y un gem containing un celestial bound by un rhevanna tiene Dureza 40.

Si el rhevanna destroys un gem en que ellos placed un celestial, el celestial es destruido forever.

Rigged Cubby.name: Rigged Cubby
Rigged Cubby.description: Un oculto string connected a precariously stacked bricks causes el cubby a collapse en en itself cuando el string es pulled.
Rigged Cubby.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Cut String|traits:action:disable-a-device] a cut el string sin setting off el trampa

action->Collapse.name: Desplome
action->Collapse.description:
Desencadenante A criatura touches the sickle in the cubby

Efecto The heavy bricks above the cubby collapse, leaving the sickle unscathed but dealing @Damage[(4d6+10)[bludgeoning]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] salvación) to the triggering criatura.

weapon->+2 Greater Striking War Razor.name: +2 Greater Striking War Razor
weapon->+2 Greater Striking War Razor.description: A war razor is an exaggerated version of the barbers' tool. It is a brittle but extremely sharp arma that is very easy to slip into a pocket or sleeve.

equipment->Necklace of Fireballs VI.description:
Este string of beads appears to be a hemp string with lustrous red beads of various sizes hanging from it. When activated, it briefly appears in its true form: a golden chain with golden spheres attached by fine threads.

Este necklace has one @Damage[16d6[fire]] daño, three @Damage[14d6[fire]] daño and four @Damage[12d6[fire]] daño beads with a Reflex save DC of 36. When all the beads are gone, the necklace becomes a non-magical hemp string.

Activar A INTERACT

Efecto Tú detach a sphere from the necklace, causing it to glow with orange light. After tú activate a sphere, if tú or anyone else hurls it (an INTERACT action with the ranged rasgo), it detonates as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball} where it lands. Tu toss can place the center of the fireball anywhere within 70 pies, though at the GM's discretion tú might need to make an tirada de ataque if the throw is unusually challenging. If no one hurls the sphere by the start of tu next turn, it turns into a non-magical red bead.

action->Bloody Mayhem.name: Bloody Mayhem
action->Bloody Mayhem.description: Sad Liza Strides three times. Once per Zancada, she can attempt a war razor Golpe against a criatura in her reach at any point during the Zancada; she must make each Golpe against a different criatura, but she doesn't apply her multiple attack penalización until after making all her Golpes. If any of the Golpes are a critical failure, Bloody Mayhem immediately ends.

action->Close Cutter.name: Close Cutter
action->Close Cutter.description: Siempre que Sad Liza deals daño cortante, el objetivo takes an additional 2d10 daño persistente de sangrado.

action->Fan of Daggers.name: Fan of Daggers
action->Fan of Daggers.description: Sad Liza makes three ranged dagger Golpes, each against a separate target; she ignores the multiple attack penalización until after making all three Golpes. On a impacto crítico, el objetivo takes @Damage[2d10[bleed]] daño and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} for 1 asalto.

action->Knife Thrower.name: Knife Thrower
action->Knife Thrower.description: Sad Liza's ranged dagger Golpes have a range increment of 20 pies instead of 10 pies.

Este wand features a carved dragon's head at its top and a polished metal sphere set in its midsection.

Activar Lanzar un conjuro

Frecuencia Una vez al día, más sobrecarga

Efecto Lanzas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} at 3rd rank.

After tú cast the conjuro, an additional missile or missiles are released from the wand at the start of each of tu turns, as though tú cast the 1-action version of magic missile. Elige targets each time. Este lasts for 1 minuto, until estás no longer wielding the wand, or until tú try to activate the wand again.

Requisitos de fabricación Supply a casting of magic missile of the appropriate rank.

action->Drain Wand.name: Drain Wand
action->Drain Wand.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Requisitos Scathka hasn't acted yet on their turn

Efecto On their turn, Scathka casts one conjuro they've prepared and already cast this day without spending a conjuro slot. Scathka must still Lanzar el conjuro and meet the conjuro's other requirements.

action->Throw Shadow Blade.name: Throw Shadow Blade
action->Throw Shadow Blade.description:
Requisito Scathka is wielding a dagger

Efecto Scathka draws a shadowy glyph on the dagger's blade and flings it at a nearby foe. Scathka makes a ranged Golpe with the dagger with the range increment to 30 pies.

If the Golpe hits, it deals @Damage[8d6[cold]] daño (double daño on a critical success) and el objetivo must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:32] salvación or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} until the end of its next turn (or [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos} on a critical failure).

The dagger loses its shadowy magic as soon as the attack is resolved.
