armor->Chain Shirt.description: Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

equipment->Cape of the Mountebank.name: Cape of the Mountebank
equipment->Cape of the Mountebank.description:
Este bright red-and-gold cape is often interlaced with glittery threads and serves as a distraction. While wearing the cape, obtienes a +2 bonificador por objeto to DECEPTION checks.

Activar 2 INTERACT

Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto Lanzas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate}. The space tú leave and the one tú appear in are filled with puffs of smoke that make anyone within concealed until they leave the smoke or the end of tu next turn, at which point the smoke dissipates. Strong winds immediately disperse the smoke.

equipment->Religious Symbol of Norgorber.name: Religious Symbol of Norgorber
equipment->Religious Symbol of Norgorber.description: Esta pieza de madera o plata está adornada con una imagen que representa un dios. Algunos lanzadores de conjuros divinos, como los clérigos, pueden utilizar un símbolo religioso de su dios como foco divino para utilizar ciertas habilidades y lanzar algunos conjuros. Se debe sostener un símbolo religioso en una mano para usarlo.

action->+1 Status to All Saves vs. Menta.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Mental

action->Designate Apostate.name: Designate Apostate
action->Designate Apostate.description: Velberi designates one criatura she can see within 30 pies as an apostate to the church of Norgorber, regardless of the criatura's actual religious leanings. She can have up to four apostates designated at a time; any additional apostate removes another apostate of her choice. Velberi treats all Perception checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} against an apostate as one degree of success better, and her Golpes deal an additional 2d8 daño mental to apostates.

action->Attack of Opportunity.name: Ataque de oportunidad
action->Attack of Opportunity.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Efecto The monster attempts a melee Golpe against the triggering criatura. If the attack is a impacto crítico and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. Este Golpe doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalización, and its multiple attack penalización doesn't apply to this Golpe.

action->Divert Strike.name: Divert Golpe
action->Divert Strike.description:
Desencadenante A shatterling takes non-daño contundente and there's an unbroken mirror at least 1 pies wide within 100 pies of the shatterling

Efecto The nearest mirror to the shatterling at least 1 pies wide breaks, and the daño to the shatterling is reduced to 0.

action->Extra Reaction.name: Extra Reaction
action->Extra Reaction.description: A shatterling gains an additional reaction each turn, but can use this extra reaction only for Divert Golpe.

action->Mirror Senses.name: Mirror Senses
action->Mirror Senses.description: A shatterling can see and hear through any unbroken mirror within 100 pies.

action->Blood-Fueled Titter.name: Blood-Fueled Titter
action->Blood-Fueled Titter.description: If the shatterling attempts an INTIMIDATION check to [[/act demoralize]] a target within 30 pies of a criatura with daño persistente de sangrado, the shatterling has +4 bonificador de circunstancia to the INTIMIDATION check. In addition, the shatterling takes no penalización to the check for not speaking a language el objetivo can hear, and el objetivo isn't temporarily immune to the shatterling's attempts to DEMORALIZE it unless the shatterling critically fails its INTIMIDATION check.

action->Mirror Jump.name: Mirror Jump
action->Mirror Jump.description: During this Zancada, the shatterling can move into any unbroken mirror at least 1 pies wide and out of another unbroken mirror at least 1 pies wide within 100 pies of the first mirror, treating the mirrors as connected. The shatterling can move through any number of pairs of pies-wide mirrors during its mirror jump, requiring each pair to be within 100 pies of each other while doing so.

action->Vanish in Reflections.name: Vanish in Reflections
action->Vanish in Reflections.description: The shatterling doesn't appear in reflective surfaces if it doesn't want to. When it's within 100 pies of an unbroken mirror at least 1 pies wide, a shatterling can Hide and Sneak even without cover or without being concealed.

action->Wipe Away Cracks.name: Wipe Away Cracks
action->Wipe Away Cracks.description: El shatterling touches un roto mirror, instantly repairing ello.

weapon->+1 Striking Scimitar.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.grmaV4GdoGD7sKbn]
+1 Striking Scimitar

shield->Wooden Shield.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ezVp13Uw8cWW08Da]

Aunque existen en una gran variedad de formas y tamaños, the protection offered by wooden shields comes from the stoutness of their materials. While wooden shields are less expensive than steel shields, they break more easily.

Hardness HP BT
3 12 6

consumable->Darkvision Elixir (Moderate).description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Y8115p3cmQJBqk5d]

Activar 1 INTERACT

After tú drink this elixir, tu sight becomes sharper in darkness. Obtienes darkvision for 1 hora.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.bcxVvIbuZWOvsKcA]{Efecto: Darkvision Elixir (Moderate)}

action->Deep Breath.name: Contener La Respiración
action->Deep Breath.description: Un Shikwashim mercenary puede contener la respiracion for 20 minutos.

action->Coordinated Distraction.name: Distracción coordinada
action->Coordinated Distraction.description:
With a sharp whistle or wave of their hand, the mercenary distracts an opponent so one of the mercenary's allies can land a clean blow.

The mercenary chooses a target and an ally, both of whom must be within 30 pies of the mercenary. El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} against the first Golpe the mercenary's ally makes on its next turn; if the ally doesn't Golpe that target, the effect is lost.

Depending on how the mercenary distracts their foe, this action gains either the auditory or visual rasgo.

action->Human Hunter.name: Human Hunter
action->Human Hunter.description: A Shikwashim mercenary's multiple attack penalización for attacks against humans is -3 (-2 with an agile arma) on their second attack per turn or -6 (-4 with an agile arma) on their third or subsequent attack per turn.

action->Powerful Swipe.name: Powerful Swipe
action->Powerful Swipe.description:
The Shikwashim mercenary makes a melee Golpe. If it hits, it deals an extra die of daño.

Este counts as two attacks for the mercenary's multiple attack penalización.

action->Terrain Advantage.name: Ventaja De Terreno
action->Terrain Advantage.description: Non-lizardfolk criaturas in difficult terrain and non-lizardfolk criaturas that are in water and lack a Swim speed are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to a Shikwashim mercenary.

action->Compression.name: Compression
action->Compression.description: Cuando un shredskin successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeezes}, ello mueve through el tight espacio at full speed. Narrow confines son no terreno dificil for un shredskin.

action->Constrict.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.g26YiEIfSHCpLocV]

@Damage[(1d4+4)[bludgeoning]] daño, @Check[fortitude|dc:16|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Constrict]

action->Control Body.name: Control Body
action->Control Body.description:
Requisitos The shredskin is adjacent to a Medium or Small humanoid-shaped corpse

Efecto The shredskin wraps itself around the corpse and takes control of the host body. While controlling a host, the shredskin uses the host's Velocidad but its own attacks, and it loses its GRAB and Enshroud abilities.

Attacks that target the shredskin while it controls a body deal half of the daño to the shredskin and half of the daño to the host body. Attacks that target an area deal daño to both the shredskin and host body normally.

The shredskin can release the host body as a free action at the start of its turn. If the host is destroyed, the shredskin automatically releases the body and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} for 1 asalto. A Medium corpse typically has 15 hit points, while a Small corpse typically has 10 Puntos de Golpe.

Las criaturas can notice that a corpse is controlled by a shredskin by succeeding a Perception check against the shredskin's DECEPTION DC.

action->Enshroud.name: Enshroud
action->Enshroud.description:
Requisitos The shredskin is grabbing a criatura

Efecto The shredskin attempts to pin the criatura and wrap itself around the criatura like a shirt. The shredskin rolls an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the criatura's Fortitude DC.

On a success, the criatura becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado} and the shredskin can take control of the criatura as if using Control Body.

At the start of its turn, the shredskin can automatically Constrict the enshrouded criatura as a free action.

An enshrouded criatura can attempt a DC 16 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} check to break free (DC 18 if the shredskin critically succeeded its ATHLETICS check to Enshroud).

treasure->Victor's Medallion from the Ch.name: Victor's Medallion from the Challenge of Sky and Heaven

action->Flurry of Blows.name: Ráfaga De Golpes
action->Flurry of Blows.description:
Shristi makes two unarmed Golpes. If both hit the same criatura, combine their daño for the purposes of resistances and weaknesses. He applies his multiple attack penalización to the Golpes normally.

As it has the flourish rasgo, Shristi can use Flurry of Blows only once per turn.

action->Heaven's Thunder.name: Trueno del cielo
action->Heaven's Thunder.description:
Frecuencia twice per day

Efecto With a loud shout, Shristi unleashes his ki as a crackling shroud of thunder and lightning that engulfs his body. Until the end of his next turn, Shristi's unarmed Golpes and Golpes with armas that have the monk rasgo deal an additional 3 daño de electricidad and 3 daño sónico.

action->Sky and Heaven Stance.name: Postura del cielo y el cielo
action->Sky and Heaven Stance.description:
Shristi enters a combat stance perfected by past champions of the Challenge of Sky and Heaven. While in this stance, the only Golpes Shristi can make are skyward slash ataques sin armas. Estos deal 1d10 daño cortante; are in the brawling group; and have the nonlethal, unarmed, and versatile P rasgos.

While in Sky and Heaven Stance, Shristi gains resistance 2 to electricity and daño sónico.

action->Exorcism.name: Exorcism
action->Exorcism.description:
Mental daño ignores a siege shard's hardness.

Additionally, proving the siege shard's generative conflict is over with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ma93dpT4K7JbP9gu]{Prove Peace} activity reverts the criatura to ordinary stone.

action->Surreptitious Siege.name: Surreptitious Siege
action->Surreptitious Siege.description: While a siege shard is embedded within a structure while using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vh1RpbWfqdNC4L3P]{One with Stone}, the structure and all objects within it take twice as long to REPAIR.

action->Overwhelming Anguish.name: Overwhelming Anguish
action->Overwhelming Anguish.description:
Frecuencia una vez por minuto

Efecto The siege shard emits a disorienting psychic blast. All criaturas within a @Template[emanation|distance:15] take @Damage[4d6[mental]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[will|dc:20|basic|options:area-effect] salvación).

action->Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenecimiento
action->Rejuvenation.description:
When a siege shard is destroyed within 100 pies of a structure, it reforms after [[/br 2d4 #days]] days within the nearest structure, fully healed.

A siege shard within a structure can permanently destroyed by the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.QW2gYIKce3W31xXf]{Prove Peace} activity.

action->Distracting Shadows.name: Sombras distractoras
action->Distracting Shadows.description: Skebs can use criaturas that are at least one size larger than themself as cover for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} actions.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

equipment->Skinsaw Mask.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.sgH9U2fKqWCedKNO]

A patchwork of humanoid flesh makes up this grotesque mask stitched together with black silk or wire. It is distinctive for its bulbous orange eye- crafted from a magical glass bauble-and wide row of teeth.

When worn, the mask amplifies tu ability to sense fear in other criaturas.

Tú automatically know the value of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado} condition of any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observado} criatura, and obtienes a +1 bonificador por objeto to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} asustado criaturas. Siempre que tú deal daño de precisión to a asustado criatura, tú deal 1 daño adicional de precisión.

If estás not evil, estás @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 2} while wearing the Skinsaw mask.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

When attacking an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criatura, the Skinsaw murderer deals 1d6 daño adicional de precisión.

action->Twin Takedown.name: Derribo gemelo
action->Twin Takedown.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Requisito Estás wielding two melee armas, each in a different hand.

Efecto Tú swiftly attack tu hunted prey with both armas. Make two Golpes against a criatura, one with each of the required armas. If both hit the same criatura, combine their daño for the purpose of its resistances and weaknesses. Apply tu multiple attack penalización to each Golpe normally.

action->Wire Catch.name: Wire Catch
action->Wire Catch.description:
Every Skinsaw seamer keeps a sewing needle attached to a loop of thick silk, wrapped loosely around their hand not holding a arma, which they can use in combat to snag or disarm attackers

Desencadenante A criatura hits the seamer with a melee Golpe

Efecto The seamer attempts an ATHLETICS check to either [[/act grapple]] or [[/act disarm]] the triggering criatura.

action->Flay.name: Flay
action->Flay.description:
Requisitos The Skinsaw seamer dealt daño with a melee arma other than its war razor with their last action

Efecto The seamer makes a war razor Golpe against the same criatura that they just damaged. On a hit, the seamer slices a strip of flesh from el objetivo and deals @Damage[1d6[bleed]] in addition to the war razor's usual daño.

action->Quick Stitch.name: Quick Stitch
action->Quick Stitch.description:
Requisitos The Skinsaw seamer is currently grappling a criatura

Efecto The seamer stitches a piece of cloth to the criatura's arm, face, or leg, potentially hindering it. The criatura must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:26|traits:damaging-effect] tirada de salvación; if the seamer has already successfully used their Flay ability against the criatura within the past minute, the criatura's save result is one degree of success worse.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura takes @Damage[1d4[piercing]] daño.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Deslumbrado}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} (seamer's choice). Este effect lasts until the criatura spends a single action to tear out the stitching, which deals @Damage[1d6[piercing]] daño to it.

Fallo crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2}, or desprevenido (seamer's choice). Este effect lasts until the criatura spends 2 actions to tear out the stitching, which deals @Damage[2d6[piercing]] daño to it.

action->Pest Haven.name: Pest Haven
action->Pest Haven.description:
The rotting hides and molding straw stuffing of skitterstitches are ideal nesting grounds for vermin and insect swarms. Any animal swarm sharing a space with a skitterstitch gains curacion rapida 3.

Additionally, if a criatura deals at least 10 piercing or daño cortante to the skitterstitchstitch, the swarm can use its swarming bites Golpe (or similar attack) against the attacker as a reaction.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.CM14G9kLI97aIC5h]{Efecto: Pest Haven}

action->Spider Swarm Host.name: Spider Swarm Host
action->Spider Swarm Host.description: Skitterstitches host un @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.NcYbJS5PWBGdNDqh]{Spider Swarm} dentro de themselves, que erupts out cuando el Skitterstitch es destruido

action->Flay.name: Flay
action->Flay.description: The skitterstitch makes a blade Golpe against an animal or humanoid. On a success, the skitterstitch slices a long strip of flesh from el objetivo; if the skitterstitch dealt daño, it deals an additional 1d6 daño persistente de sangrado.

action->Skitterstitch Venom.name: Skitterstitch Venom
action->Skitterstitch Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:23|traits:poison]

Duración máxima 6 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[1d10[poison]] daño, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[1d10[poison]] daño, desprevenido, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2} (1 asalto)

action->Stitch Skin.name: Stitch Skin
action->Stitch Skin.description:
Requisitos The skitterstitch hasn't used this ability since the last time it successfully used its Flay ability

Efecto The skitterstitch sews flayed flesh to its body to seal tears and rents. The skitterstitch regains @Damage[8[healing]] Puntos de Golpe.

weapon->+1 Striking Temple Sword.name: +1 Striking Temple Sword
weapon->+1 Striking Temple Sword.description: Este heavy blade is favored by guardians of religious sites. It has a distinctive, crescent-shaped blade that seems to be a mix of a sickle and sword. It often has holes drilled into the blade or the pommel so that bells or other holy trinkets can be affixed to the arma as an aid for prayer or mediation.

shield->Steel Shield.description:
Like wooden shields, steel shields come in a variety of shapes and sizes. Though more expensive than wooden shields, they are much more durable.

Hardness HP BT
5 20 10

ammo->Arrows.name: Flechas
ammo->Arrows.description: Estos projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

action->Attack of Opportunity.name: Ataque de oportunidad
action->Attack of Opportunity.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Efecto The monster attempts a melee Golpe against the triggering criatura. If the attack is a impacto crítico and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. Este Golpe doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalización, and its multiple attack penalización doesn't apply to this Golpe.

action->Wary.name: Wary
action->Wary.description: The veteran isn't desprevenido to hidden criaturas and always gains a +4 bonificador de circunstancia to their Perception DC against criaturas attempting to Create a Diversion or Lie to the veteran.

action->Power Attack.name: Ataque Poderoso
action->Power Attack.description: The veteran makes a melee Golpe that counts as two attacks when calculating their multiple attack penalización. If this strike hits, it deals an extra die of daño del arma.

action->Swipe.name: Barrido
action->Swipe.description: The veteran makes a melee Golpe and compares the tirada de ataque result to the AC of up to two foes, each of whom must be within their melee reach and adjacent to each other. Roll daño only once and apply it to each criatura hit. A Swipe counts as two attacks for the veteran's multiple attack penalización.

action->Tremorsense (Imprecise) 120 feet.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.j2wsK6IsW5yMW1jW]
Tremorsense (Imprecise) 120 pies

action->Transparent.name: Transparent
action->Transparent.description:
A slithering rift is so clear that it's difficult to spot. A successful @Check[perception|dc:48] check is required to notice a stationary slithering rift, and a criatura must be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Searching} to attempt this check.

A criatura that walks into the rift's space might fall into any pit currently in effect due to Dimensional Pit.

action->Breach Vulnerability.name: Breach Vulnerability
action->Breach Vulnerability.description:
Ingesting an extradimensional space like that found in a bag of holding deals @Damage[12d8[force]] daño to the slithering rift and its occupants.

The slithering rift then immediately uses Out Tú Go.

action->Dimensional Pit.name: Dimensional Pit
action->Dimensional Pit.description:
The slithering rift opens an extradimensional, 20-pies-deep pit that covers its own space and all adjacent squares unless they are walls or similarly blocking terrain.

Any other criatura occupying spaces in the pit must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:40|traits:damaging-effect] salvación or fall into the pit, taking daño from the fall (typically @Damage[10[bludgeoning]] daño). Any criatura grabbed by the ooze is released from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.i18TlebMzwONyPhI]{GRAB} and falls in, even if it was outside the pit squares.

While the pit is open, the slithering rift is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} and can't be forced to move. It can make pseudopod Golpes originating from the walls of the pit. A criatura that starts its turn at the bottom of the pit takes @Damage[5d6[acid]] daño.

Las criaturas can CLIMB the walls with a @Check[athletics|dc:40|name:Climb Out of the Rift|traits:action:climb] check. When the slithering rift dies, the pit closes and criaturas inside are ejected, as Out tú Go.

action->Flurry of Pods.name: Flurry of Pods
action->Flurry of Pods.description:
The slithering rift makes a single pseudopod Golpe against each target within range it hasn't already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado}.

Estos attacks count toward the slithering rift's multiple attack penalización, but this penalización doesn't increase until after all of these attacks.

action->Out You Go.name: Out Tú Go
action->Out You Go.description:
The slithering rift closes all pit spaces it created using Dimensional Pit, ejecting all its occupants onto the ground into random free spaces where the opening of the pit was.

Each occupant takes @Damage[9d6[bludgeoning]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic] salvación).

weapon->Thunderstone (Greater).name: Thunderstone (Greater)
weapon->Thunderstone (Greater).description:
When this stone hits a criatura or a hard surface, it explodes with a deafening bang. A thunderstone deals the listed daño sónico and daño de salpicadura de sónico, and each criatura within 10 pies of the space in which the stone exploded must succeed at a Fortitude tirada de salvación with the listed DC or be deafened until the end of its next turn. Many types of thunderstone grant an bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque.

Obtienes a +2 bonificador por objeto to tiradas de ataque. La bomba causa 3d4 daño sónico and 3 daño de salpicadura de sónico, and the DC is 28.

weapon->+1 Striking Longsword.name: +1 Striking Longsword
weapon->+1 Striking Longsword.description: Longswords can be one-edged or two-edged swords. Their blades are heavy and they're between 3 and 4 pies in length.

armor->Chain Shirt.description: Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

ammo->Bolts.name: Virotes
ammo->Bolts.description: Mas cortos que las flechas tradicionales pero de construccion similar, los virotes son la municion que usan las ballestas.

action->Binding Blast.name: Binding Blast
action->Binding Blast.description: A commando's thunderstone is infused with special reagents to produce a blinding flash of light. In addition to the thunderstone's normal effects, criaturas that fail the tirada de salvación against the thunderstone are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Deslumbrado} for 1 asalto. Las criaturas that critically fail are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} for 1 asalto. Las criaturas who protect their eyes, such as by wearing tinted goggles, are immune to the infused thunderstone's blinding effect.

action->Target Culprit.name: Target Culprit
action->Target Culprit.description: The commando designates a single criatura as their culprit. The commando gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} their culprit and a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to SURVIVAL checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} their culprit. The commando's attacks deal an additional 2d8 daño de precisión to the culprit. Este designation lasts for 24 horas or until the commando targets another criatura with this ability.

Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil).name: Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil)
Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil).description: A summoning circle inlaid into the room's floor detects living criaturas and summons a violent devil.
Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil).disable: @Check[perception|dc:18|name:Notice the Trap's Magic|traits:action:seek] to notice the trap's magic and avoid stepping on the floor outside the circle, followed by @Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Break Summoning Circle|traits:action:disable-a-device] (entrenado) to break the circle or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (3rd rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract the rune
Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil).reset: La trampa resets each day at dawn.

action->Summon Devil.name: Summon Devil
action->Summon Devil.description:
Desencadenante A living criatura steps on any part of the floor not enclosed by the summoning circle

Efecto One round after a criatura touches the triggering area, the door to the room slams shut and locks (two [[/act pick-a-lock dc=20]]{THIEVERY} checks to pick) and a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.FIoRPHaHdYUPVKdT]{Barbazu} devil appears in the summoning circle.

The devil rolls initiative and remains for [[/br 3d6 #rounds]]{3d6 rounds}, after which the conjuro ends and the devil disappears. The devil also disappears if someone disables the trap before the duration expires.

The summoned devil can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned criaturas.

Summoning Rune (Cinder Rat).name: Summoning Rune (Cinder Rat)
Summoning Rune (Cinder Rat).description: An invisible cloud of magical sensors detects living criaturas in the room and summons fire elementals to slay the criaturas.
Summoning Rune (Cinder Rat).disable: @Check[acrobatics|dc:22|name:Approach Rune] (entrenado) to approach without triggering the trap, followed by @Check[thievery|dc:22|name:Erase Summoning Rune|traits:action:disable-a-device] (entrenado) to erase the rune or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (3rd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract the rune
Summoning Rune (Cinder Rat).reset: La trampa resets each day at dawn.

action->Summon Elementals.name: Summon Elementals
action->Summon Elementals.description:
Desencadenante A living criatura enters the room

Efecto Two rounds after a criatura enters the room, the room's door slams shut and locks (two [[/act pick-a-lock dc=20]]{THIEVERY} checks to pick), and two @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.xN5J9S485LxFZMkL]{Cinder Rat} fire elementals emerge from the floor.

The elementals roll initiative and remain for [[/gmr 3d6 #rounds]]{3d6 rounds}, after which the conjuro ends and the criaturas disappear. The elementals also disappear if someone disables the trap before the duration expires.

The summoned elementals can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned criaturas.

Supplicant Statues.name: Supplicant Statues
Supplicant Statues.description: Six statues rapidly slide around el sala en rollers, slowing down intruders y striking at them con spring-loaded sword arms.
Supplicant Statues.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:34|name:Disable Statue Rollers|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) to disable a specific statue's rollers, or @Check[thievery|dc:39|name:Disable Trap (Control Panel)|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) on the control panel in A4 deactivates the whole trap. For each statue disabled, the trap loses 1 action from its routine and the DC for its predictive impediment ability decreases by 4. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank, counteract DC 32) doesn't harm the statues but removes the predictive impediment ability. Breaking the control panel prevents the trap from resetting.
Supplicant Statues.reset: La trampa deactivates and resets one minute after the room is empty.
Supplicant Statues.routine: (6 actions) On the trap's initiative, each functioning statue slides up to 40 pies around the room and makes a statue shortsword Golpe against an adjacent criatura. La trampa doesn't take a multiple attack penalización, and the statues' movements don't trigger reactions.

action->Animated Statues.name: Animated Statues
action->Animated Statues.description:
Desencadenante A criatura enters a square adjacent to a statue

Efecto La trampa makes a statue shortsword Golpe against the triggering criatura, activates its predictive impediment ability, and then rolls initiative.

action->Predictive Impediment.name: Predictive Impediment
action->Predictive Impediment.description: The statues continually slide around to bump into criaturas and block their passage through the room. The first time on its turn that a criatura attempts to move within the room, it must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:36] salvación or treat the entire room as difficult terrain for 1 asalto. On a critical failure, the criatura is also knocked prone.

spell->Chill Touch.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.mAMEt4FFbdqoRnkN]
Chill Touch

spell->Produce Flame.name: Produce Flame
spell->Produce Flame.description:
A small ball of flame appears in the palm of tu hand, and tú lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a conjuro tirada de ataque against tu target's AC. Este is normally a ranged attack, but puedes also make a melee attack against a criatura in tu unarmed reach.

On a success, tú deal 2d4 daño de fuego. On a critical success, el objetivo takes double daño and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] daño.

Heightened (+1) Increase the daño by 1d4 and the daño persistente on a impacto crítico by 1d4.

spell->Ray of Enfeeblement.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J7Y7tl0bbdz7TcCc]
Ray of Enfeeblement

spell->True Strike.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.mgrabKkyLmvxgLBK]
+1 Striking Elven Curve Blade

consumable->Graveroot.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qQqAY59NgGNoy2xr]

The opaque white sap from the graveroot shrub clouds the mind.

Activar 2 INTERACT (Injury)

Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:19]

Duración máxima 4 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[1d10[poison]] daño (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[1d12[poison]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 @Damage[2d6[poison]] daño and stupefied 2 (1 asalto)

action->Shadow Step.name: Shadow Dar un paso
action->Shadow Step.description:
The svartalfar killer fades into shadow, Strides up to twice its Velocidad, and reforms.

Este movement no desencadena reacciones, but the svartalfar killer must begin and end in an area of dim light or darkness.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

A svartalfar killer deals an extra 2d6 daño de precisión to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

action->Spell-Imbued Blade.name: Spell-Imbued Blade
action->Spell-Imbued Blade.description:
The svartalfar killer chooses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gISYsBFby1TiXfBt]{Acid Splash}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6DfLZBl8wKIV03Iq]{Ignition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J7Y7tl0bbdz7TcCc]{Enfeeble}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r3NeUnsgt9mS03Sn]{Shocking Grasp} and makes a melee Golpe.

If the svartalfar killer hits, they cast the chosen conjuro through the arma at the same target. The conjuro's tirada de ataque is the same result as the Golpe.

action->Obscuring Grab.name: Obscuring Grab
action->Obscuring Grab.description: While the tenome is Grabbing a criatura, all other criaturas are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} to the tenome.

action->Bone Drink.name: Bone Drink
action->Bone Drink.description:
Requisito The tenome has a criatura grabbed or restrained

Efecto The tenome makes a jaws Golpe against the grabbed or restrained criatura. If the Golpe hits, the criatura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1} (or the value of the criatura's drained condition increases by 1 if it already has a drained value, to a maximum of drained 4).

The tenome regains [[/r 1d8[healing]]] Puntos de Golpe each time it uses Bone Drink.

action->Burst of Velocidad.name: Burst of Velocidad
action->Burst of Velocidad.description:
The tenome Strides twice, Steps twice, or Steps and Strides (in either order).

It cannot use Burst of Velocidad again for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Terrifying Gaze.name: Terrifying Gaze
action->Terrifying Gaze.description:
1 or 2 actions

A tenome can gaze at a criatura within 30 pies by presenting one of its eyes. El objetivo must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:21] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}. If the tenome uses 2 actions and presents both of its eyes, el objetivo is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} if it fails the save.

A criatura that successfully saves is temporarily immune for 24 horas.

action->Emotion Sense 120 feet.name: Emotion Sense 120 pies
action->Emotion Sense 120 feet.description: A teraphant can sense the emotions of criaturas within 120 pies as an imprecise sense. Emotion sense is a precise sense against criaturas under an emotion effect. A criatura under the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b515AZlB0sridKSq]{Calm} can't be noticed via emotion sense.

action->Empathetic Response.name: Empathetic Response
action->Empathetic Response.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within 60 pies of the teraphant is targeted by a conjuro or ability with the emotion rasgo

Efecto The teraphant also benefits from the conjuro or effect, as though it were an additional target for 1 minuto or until the triggering conjuro or ability ends.

action->Impale.name: Impale
action->Impale.description:
Requisito The teraphant has a criatura grabbed

Efecto The teraphant slams the criatura onto one of its horns. El objetivo must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] salvación or suffer @Damage[(3d6+9)[piercing]] daño and @Damage[1d6[bleed]] (@Damage[(6d6+18)[piercing]] daño on a critical failure).

action->Psychokinetic Trumpet.name: Psychokinetic Trumpet
action->Psychokinetic Trumpet.description:
The teraphant lets out a loud trumpet that deals @Damage[8d8[mental]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[will|dc:27|basic|options:area-effect,forced-movement] salvación) in a @Template[cone|distance:30]. A criatura that fails its save is also pushed 15 pies (30 pies on a critical failure).

If a pushed criaturas strikes a solid barrier, it takes @Damage[3d6[bludgeoning]] daño and stops.

The teraphant can't use Psychokinetic Trumpet again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Psychokinetic Trumpet]]{1d4 asaltos}.

action->Trample.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.UNah0bxXxkcZjxO3]

Large or smaller, pies, @Check[reflex|dc:27|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

action->Grabbing Trunk.name: Grabbing Trunk
action->Grabbing Trunk.description: A Medium or smaller criatura hit by the teraphant's trunk is grabbed. If the teraphant moves, it can bring the grabbed criatura along with it.

The Inkmaster.name: The Inkmaster
The Inkmaster.publicNotes:
Shemhazians rise from the souls of torturers and those who reveled in mutilating the physical bodies of their victims. Standing 35 pies tall, a shemhazian is well equipped with a wide range of talons, claws, and fangs to continue inflicting such torments on those it encounters.

Shemhazians delight in visiting torment upon mortals, of course, but more than most demons, these fiends revel in sharing the pain with their own kind. Other demons fear and hate shemhazians for this reason, with only the most powerful willing to work with a shemhazian to achieve a shared goal. Even then, the shemhazian is always on the watch for an opportunity to bring pain and suffering to its allies along with any foe.
The Inkmaster.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

spell->True Seeing.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]
True Seeing

Puerta dimensional

spell->Prying Eye.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Ek5XI0aEdZhBgm21]
Prying Eye

spell->Abyssal Pact.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tsKnoBuBbKMXkiz5]
Abyssal Pact

action->Clockwork Brain.name: Clockwork Brain
action->Clockwork Brain.description: Un second brain, made de clockwork, es implanted en el Inkmaster's skull. Any time el makes un salvacion de Voluntad, el rolls twice y recibe el higher result.

action->Paralyzing Gaze.name: Paralyzing Gaze
action->Paralyzing Gaze.description: 30 pies. A non-evil criatura that ends its turn in the aura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:35|options:area-effect,inflicts:ralentizado,inflicts:paralyzed] salvación. If it fails, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 asalto, and if it critically fails, it is instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 asalto.

action->Succor Vulnerability.name: Succor Vulnerability
action->Succor Vulnerability.description: A shemhazian's mutilation is a part of them, and they can't bear to see it reversed. The first time each round that a criatura heals from daño the shemhazian dealt on their last turn, the demon takes @Damage[3d6[mental]] daño.

action->Tail Whip.name: Tail Whip
action->Tail Whip.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within reach of the shemhazian's tail leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Efecto The shemhazian attempts to [[/act trip]] the triggering criatura. On a success, the criatura also takes daño as if the shemhazian had hit with a tail Golpe, and if the criatura was flying, it falls 30 pies.

action->Enfeebling Bite.name: Enfeebling Bite
action->Enfeebling Bite.description: If the shemhazian's jaws Golpe damages a criatura, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 3}. El objetivo can attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:37] salvación to reduce this to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} (or be unaffected on a critical success).

action->Focused Gaze.name: Focused Gaze
action->Focused Gaze.description: The shemhazian focuses their gaze on a non-evil criatura they can see within 30 pies. If that criatura isn't already ralentizado by the shemhazian's paralyzing gaze, it must attempt a save against the shemhazian's paralyzing gaze. If that criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado}, it must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:35] salvación or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} for 1 asalto. A shemhazian can't use this ability against the same criatura more than una vez por asalto.

action->Improved Grab.name: Agarrón mejorado
action->Improved Grab.description:
Requisitos The monster's last action was a success with a Golpe that lists Improved GRAB in its daño entry, or it has a criatura grabbed using this action.

Efecto The monster automatically Grabs el objetivo until the end of the monster's next turn. The criatura is grabbed by whichever body part the monster attacked with, and that body part can't be used to Golpe criaturas until the GRAB is ended. Using Improved GRAB extends the duration of the monster's Improved GRAB until the end of its next turn for all criaturas grabbed by it, but this costs an action. A grabbed criatura can use the Escape action to get out of the GRAB, and the GRAB ends for a grabbed criaturas if the monster moves away from it.

The Laughing Fiend's Greeting.name: The Laughing Fiend's Greeting
The Laughing Fiend's Greeting.description: Subtle but deadly magical runes link this mural to Kharnas's maestro. Good- or neutral-aligned criaturas who examine the mural witness the castle's drawbridge silently descend, revealing an endless darkness.
The Laughing Fiend's Greeting.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:44|name:Disable Thievery] (legendario) to obscure or mar the magical runes set into the mural, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank; counteract DC 42) to counteract the mural

action->Tegresin's Greeting.name: Tegresin's Greeting
action->Tegresin's Greeting.description:
Desencadenante A criatura capable of casting divine magic examines the mural

Efecto The mural casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qDjeG6dxT4aEEC6J]{Weird} (@Check[will|dc:43|traits:death,emotion,fear,illusion,mental,damaging-effect] salvación) on all criaturas in the gallery. A snarl fills the criaturas' minds.

Baleful Polymorph (At Will)

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]
Freedom of Movement (Constant)

spell->Inveigle.target: 1 criatura of a level no greater than double the inveigle ritual's level

weapon->Blade of the Rabbit Prince.description:
Este +2 greater striking dancing shortsword has a golden handguard resembling a bird with outstretched wings. The sword's blade is broken halfway up its length, but this doesn't impair the sword's function.

Activar 1 command, INTERACT

Efecto Intentas to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} an opponent using THIEVERY instead of ATHLETICS, and tú add the blade of the Rabbit Prince's bonificador por objeto to the check. Tú do not need to have a hand free if estás wielding the blade of the Rabbit Prince, and tu target can be up to two sizes larger than tú.

Requisitos de fabricación Debes craft the blade in the Harrowed Realm.

action->Halfling Luck.name: Suerte del mediano
action->Halfling Luck.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Desencadenante The Rabbit Prince fails a prueba de habilidad or a tirada de salvación

Efecto The Rabbit Prince rerolls the triggering check, but he must use the new result, even if it's worse.

action->Perfect Will.name: Voluntad perfecta
action->Perfect Will.description: Si el Rabbit Prince rolls un success en un salvacion de Voluntad, el gets un exito critico en su lugar, y si el rolls un critical failure, el gets un failure instead.

action->Superior Senses.name: Superior Senses

The first time Tyrroicese uses this ability, it summons an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.uQBOJfjtzEXvpLQz]{Ochre Jelly}, which leaks out of the ceiling of area D13 and drops to the floor to join the fight, siding with Tyrroicese.

Thereafter, when Tyrroicese uses this ability, any oozes within 60 pies become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado} for 1 asalto (the oozes can use their extra action only to Zancada) and, if they're not allied with the agents, the oozes ally themselves with Tyrroicese.

Frecuencia una vez por asalto

action->Subsume.description:
Tyrroicese lifts an adjacent dying criatura with its pseudopods and subsumes that criatura into its own oozy flesh. The subsumed criatura's dying value does not increase, though it can't decrease either.

Tyrroicese regains @Damage[30[healing]] HP and also gains the ability to use one or two of the subsumed criatura's special abilities or feats, subject to the GM's discretion.

A criatura adjacent to Tyrroicese can extract a subsumed criatura by spending 2 actions to attempt a @Check[athletics|dc:29|name:Extract Subsumed Creature] check.

On a success, the subsumed criatura is pulled from Tyrroicese and falls into the nearest available space.

60 pies. Any criatura that ends its turn in the aura while in possession of any crystals, gemstones, or other precious stones must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:39|traits:damaging-effect] salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected and is immune to the aura for 1 hora.

Fallo The criatura's crystals reverberate with Ulressia's vengeful aura, sharpening at every corner and digging, as if powerfully magnetized, into the criatura's flesh.

The criatura takes @Damage[4d6[piercing]] daño, plus @Damage[5[void]] daño for every 2,000 gp the crystals are cumulatively worth (maximum 40 daño).

The criatura can't discard the crystals until they leave the aura or roll a successful save against it.

Fallo crítico As failure, but @Damage[8d6[piercing]] daño, plus @Damage[10[void]] daño for every 2,000 gp of the crystals' value (maximum 80 daño).

Ulressia can deactivate or activate this aura using a single action, which has the concentrate rasgo.

action->Spell Circle.name: Spell Circle
action->Spell Circle.description: By performing an hour-long ritual, an elemental vessel can form a conjuro circle with an arcane or primal spellcaster. After the conjuro circle is formed, other spellcasters can join the conjuro circle by performing the same hour-long ritual while assisted by at least one spellcaster already in the conjuro circle. Each member of the conjuro circle must contribute at least one conjuro to the elemental vessel. The spellcaster permanently loses access to a conjuro slot equal to the conjuro's rank and the elemental vessel adds the contributed conjuro to its list of arcane innate conjuros (regardless of the conjuro's original type). An elemental vessel can be imbued with no more than three conjuros per conjuro rank. If the elemental vessel is destroyed, all members of the conjuro circle regain the conjuro slots they contributed to the criatura. The arcane innate conjuros shown below represent a typical conjuro list for an elemental vessel, but each elemental vessel is likely to have different conjuros depending on what its conjuro circle has contributed.

action->Dispel Vulnerability.name: Dispel Vulnerability
action->Dispel Vulnerability.description: Siempre que a criatura successfully counteracts one of its conjuros, the vessel permanently loses access to that conjuro and takes daño equal to 4 × the conjuro's rank. The conjuro circle member who contributed that conjuro regains access to their contributed conjuro slot.

action->Inhabit Vessel.name: Inhabit Vessel
action->Inhabit Vessel.description: Any member of the elemental vessel's conjuro circle can spend 3 actions to mentally inhabit the vessel for 1 asalto. While they inhabit the vessel, the inhabiter controls the vessel's actions, and the vessel uses the inhabiter's INTELLIGENCE, Wisdom, and Charisma modifiers for all checks. Only one criatura can inhabit an elemental vessel at a time.

Waxworks Onslaught Trap.name: Waxworks Onslaught Trap
Waxworks Onslaught Trap.description: Four enorme tubs containing congealed wax, enchanted a melt y envelop unwary intruders, cada sit atop un frio fuego.
Waxworks Onslaught Trap.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:43|name:Drain Wax from a Tub|traits:action:disable-a-device] (maestro) to drain the wax from a tub or @Check[athletics|dc:45|name:Push Through Wax|traits:action:force-open] (maestro) to push through the wax blocking a sealed door and escape (other criaturas must push their own way through, as the wax reseals)
Waxworks Onslaught Trap.hpDetails: to destroy a tub and prevent it from making any further attacks; Door Seal Hardness 18; Door Seal HP 72 (UR 36) to destroy the wax on a sealed door and allow anyone to escape through the door
Waxworks Onslaught Trap.reset: La trampa deactivates and resets after 1 hora. At that time, the wax in the tubs cools and congeals, and any wax elsewhere in the room magically goes back into the tubs.
Waxworks Onslaught Trap.routine: (4 actions) La trampa loses 1 action each turn per drained or destroyed tub. On each action, a different tub spews hot wax at a random criatura in the room, dealing @Damage[3d12[fire]|options:area-damage] daño to el objetivo and all adjacent criaturas (@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic|options:area-effect] salvación). On a failure or critical failure, the criatura is also encased in hot wax. A criatura that starts its turn encased in wax takes @Damage[8d12[fire]] daño and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until it [[/act escape dc=35]]{Escapes} the hardening wax. Each turn it remains encased, the daño dealt by the hot wax decreases by 2d12 but the DC to Escape increases by 2 (minimum 0 daño, maximum DC 43). A criatura that can't get free from the wax might suffocate.

action->Seal Room.name: Seal Room
action->Seal Room.description:
Desencadenante A criatura comes within 5 pies of a tub

Efecto The fires beneath the vats blaze to life, magically melting the wax in the tubs. The tubs emit gouts of wax over the room's exits, sealing them shut. La trampa then rolls initiative.

action->Chain Expert.name: Chain Expert
action->Chain Expert.description: El Skinner puede effectively wield abnormally long spiked chains y puede do so using solo one hand.

action->Chain Up.name: Chain Up
action->Chain Up.description:
Requisitos The Skinner has an adjacent criatura grabbed with her spiked chain

Efecto The Skinner attempts an @Check[athletics|defense:reflex] check against the grabbed criatura's Reflex save DC. On a success, the Skinner knots her chain around the grabbed criatura, which becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado} (Escape DC = 10 + the result of the Skinner's ATHLETICS check); on a critical success, the criatura also falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

Regardless of whether the Skinner succeeds, she drops the chain.

action->Flay.name: Flay
action->Flay.description: Siempre que the Skinner makes a successful cleaver Golpe against a grabbed criatura, she also deals @Damage[1d6[bleed]] (or @Damage[2d6[bleed]] on a impacto crítico).

action->Hook and Flay.name: Hook and Flay
action->Hook and Flay.description:
Requisitos The Skinner has a criatura grabbed with her spiked chain

Efecto The Skinner pulls the criatura into the nearest open adjacent square and makes a cleaver Golpe against the criatura.

weapon->+2 Greater Striking Longsword.name: +2 Greater Striking Longsword
weapon->+2 Greater Striking Longsword.description: Longswords can be one-edged or two-edged swords. Their blades are heavy and they're between 3 and 4 pies in length.

armor->+2 Resilient Full Plate.name: +2 Resilient Full Plate
armor->+2 Resilient Full Plate.description: Plate mail consists of interlocking plates that encase nearly the entire body in a carapace of steel. It is costly and heavy, and the wearer often requires help to don it correctly, but it provides some of the best defense armor can supply. A suit of this armor comes with an undercoat of padded armor (see below) and a pair of gauntlets.

equipment->Ring of Sustenance.description: Este polished wooden ring constantly refreshes tu body and mind. Tú don't need to eat or drink while wearing it, and necesitas only 2 hours of sleep per day to gain the benefits of 8 hours of sleep. A ring of sustenance doesn't function until it's been worn and invested continuously for a week. Removing it resets this interval.

consumable->Whisper Briolette.description:
Activar 2 imaginar

Requisitos Estás an experto in STEALTH

Este teardrop-shaped gemstone has triangular facets and looks suitable for fancy attire, although close inspection shows that it's hollow. When it's activated, puedes instantly impart up to 1 minuto of speech (roughly 150 words) telepathically to any criaturas tú elige within 100 pies. Puedes impart this instantaneous telepathic message to criaturas that tú perceive and criaturas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido} to tú, but puedes't do so to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{No detectado} criaturas. Once used, the whisper briolette becomes unusable and subtly vanishes within the next few minutes, rather than crumbling to dust.

action->Attack of Opportunity.name: Ataque de oportunidad
action->Attack of Opportunity.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Efecto The monster attempts a melee Golpe against the triggering criatura. If the attack is a impacto crítico and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. Este Golpe doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalización, and its multiple attack penalización doesn't apply to this Golpe.

action->Tactical Aura.name: Tactical Aura
action->Tactical Aura.description: 60 pies. Allies of lower level than Wynsal in the aura gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.hFtNbo1LKYCoDy2O]{Attack of Opportunity} reaction. Allies who already have the Attack of Opportunity reaction can use it when a criatura within their reach uses a concentrate action, in addition to normal triggers, and they disrupt a triggering concentrate action on a impacto crítico.

action->Demanding Orders.name: Demanding Orders
action->Demanding Orders.description: Wynsal commands his allies to take action. Allies within 120 pies who hear and understand his order are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado 1} for 1 asalto and can use this extra action to Zancada, Golpe, or Dar un paso.

action->Determination.name: Determinación
action->Determination.description: Wynsal either ends a nonpermanent condition affecting him or counteracts a nonpermanent conjuro affecting him (counteract rank 17th, counteract check [[/r 1d20+30 #Counteract]]{+30}). Este doesn't remove Hit Point daño or prevent the conjuro or effect from affecting others. It can't remove an ongoing affliction or conditions from a situation outside his control (such as being grappled or flanked).

action->Formation Attack.name: Formation Attack
action->Formation Attack.description: Wynsal deals 3d8 daño adicional to any criatura that's within reach of at least two of his allies.

action->Hampering Strike.name: Hampering Golpe
action->Hampering Strike.description: A foe that takes daño from Wynsal's melee Golpe is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for 1 asalto. If it's already ralentizado, the value of the ralentizado condition increases by 1.

action->Consume Flesh.name: Consumir carne
action->Consume Flesh.description:
Requisitos The ghoul is adjacent to the corpse of an evil or chaotic criatura that died within the last hour.

Efecto The ghoul devours a chunk of the corpse and regains @Damage[6d6[healing]] Puntos de Golpe. It can regain Puntos de Golpe from any given corpse only once.

action->Ghoul Fever.name: Ghoul Fever
action->Ghoul Fever.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:27]

Etapa 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 día)

Etapa 2 @Damage[2d6[void]] daño and regains half as many Puntos de Golpe from all healing (1 día)

Etapa 3 as stage 2 (1 día)

Etapa 4 @Damage[2d6[void]] daño and gains no benefit from healing (1 día)

Etapa 5 as stage 4 (1 día)

Etapa 6 dead, and rises as a zeal-damned ghoul the next midnight.

action->Paralysis.name: Paralysis
action->Paralysis.description: Any living, non-elf criatura hit by a ghoul's attack must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado}. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

action->Swift Leap.name: Salto veloz
action->Swift Leap.description: The ghoul jumps up to half its Velocidad. Este movement no desencadena reacciones.

spell->Veil.name: Veil
spell->Veil.description:
Tú disguise the targets as other criaturas of the same body shape and roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise can hide the targets' identities or let them appear to be of another ancestry, but it's not precise enough to impersonate specific individuals. The conjuro doesn't change voice, scent, or mannerisms. Tú elige the disguise for each target; for example, tú could make one target appear to be a dwarf and another an elf. Casting veil counts as setting up a disguise for the purpose of the Impersonate action. It allows el objetivo to ignore any circumstance penalties they might take for being disguised as dissimilar criaturas, and it gives the targets a +4 bonificador de estado to DECEPTION checks to prevent others from seeing through their disguises, and add their level even if untrained. Puedes Dismiss any or all of these disguises.

Heightened (5th) The conjuro also disguises the targets' voices and scents; it gains the auditory rasgo.

Heightened (7th) The targets can appear as any criatura of the same size, even specific individuals. Debes have seen an individual to reproduce their appearance. The conjuro also disguises the targets' voices and scents; it gains the auditory rasgo.

spell->Geas (Ritual).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Q690d3mw3TUrKX7E]
Geas (Ritual)
spell->Geas (Ritual).target: 1 criatura of a level no greater than double the geas ritual's level

armor->Breastplate.description: Aunque se la denomina coraza, this type of armor consists of several pieces of plate or half-plate armor that protect the torso, chest, neck, and sometimes the hips and lower legs. It strategically grants some of the protection of plate while allowing greater flexibility and speed.

ammo->Sling Bullets.name: Balas de honda
ammo->Sling Bullets.description: Estos are small metal balls, typically either iron or lead, designed to be used as ammunition in slings.

action->Little Favors.name: Little Favors
action->Little Favors.description: Each time a criatura willingly performs a service, quest, or task for the zealborn, the criatura takes a cumulative -1 penalización de estado to tiradas de salvación against the zealborn's mental conjuros and abilities (maximum -4).

action->Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenecimiento
action->Rejuvenation.description: When a zealborn is destroyed, it re-forms, fully healed, near a follower of its choice in [[/gmr 1d10 #days]]{1d10 days}. For the purposes of rejuvenation, a follower is defined as an intelligent criatura who's well acquainted with the zealborn and is a true believer in the zealborn's mission, not merely a lukewarm supporter. A zealborn can be permanently destroyed only if they have no current followers or can be convinced to end their own life.

action->Zealous Restoration.name: Zealous Restoration
action->Zealous Restoration.description: A zealborn can't regain Puntos de Golpe through resting or curación de vacío; they feed only on the idealism of their supporters, regaining 10 Puntos de Golpe per day for each criatura under the effects of a geas cast by the zealborn. Las criaturas under a zealborn's geas have their maximum HP reduced by 10 each day until they are burned away to a husk and perish. After 24 horas, such criaturas rise as zeal-damned ghouls under the zealborn's control. Zeal-damned ghouls eat only the flesh of evil or chaotic criaturas and deal an additional 1d6 spirit and 1d6 daño de vacío with their attacks.

action->Dubious Shifting.name: Dubious Shifting
action->Dubious Shifting.description:
The zrukbat assumes the shape of any Small object or ornamentation, although the zrukbat's mimicked objects usually have unrealistic or suspicious quirks.

Este doesn't change the zrukbat's size but can alter their coloration and visual appearance.

They have an automatic result of 23 on DECEPTION checks and DCs to pass as the mimicked object.

action->Go for the Eyes.name: Go for the Eyes
action->Go for the Eyes.description:
The zrukbat flies up to its Velocidad and makes a claw Golpe at the end of its move.

If the claw attack hits, el objetivo must succeed on a @Check[fortitude|dc:15] tirada de salvación or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} for 1 asalto (or blinded for 1 minuto on a critical failure). If the Golpe was a impacto crítico, el objetivo's save result is one degree of success worse.
